senses.note: 미국의 상징 새는 bald eagle(흰머리수리). 한국어 '독수리'는 영어로 vulture(죽은 동물을 먹는 새)인 경우가 많으니 주의 — eagle 은 살아 있는 먹이를 잡는 '수리'. eagle eye = 날카로운 관찰력.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your head that you hear with

examples.en: My ears hurt on the plane.
She whispered something in my ear.

senses.note: 귀앓이 = earache, 이어폰 = earphones, 귀걸이 = earrings. 귀 기울여 듣다 = listen carefully(ear 를 쓰지 않음).

senses.meaningEn: before the usual or expected time

examples.en: You're early! The movie starts at seven.
I have an early class tomorrow.

senses.note: 형용사·부사 모두 early. 비교급 earlier(더 일찍, 조금 전에). early bird = 아침형 인간. Is it too early? = 너무 이른가요?

senses.meaningEn: before the usual time, or near the beginning of a period

examples.en: I get up early every morning.
We left early to avoid the traffic.

senses.note: early in the morning = 아침 일찍, early next week = 다음 주 초에. fast(빠른 속도)와 혼동 금지 — 시간상 '일찍'은 early.

senses.meaningEn: to get money by working

examples.en: How much do you earn a month?
She earns a good salary as a nurse.
examples.ko: 그녀는 간호사로 꽤 괜찮은 월급을 받아.

senses.note: 구어에서는 make money 를 더 많이 씀. 월급 earn, 대회 상금 win, 주식 수익은 make 로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to get something good because you worked for it

examples.en: He earned an A in math this term.
examples.ko: 그는 이번 학기 수학에서 A 를 받았어.

examples.en: You earned a break. Go rest.
examples.ko: 너 쉴 자격 있어. 가서 쉬어.

senses.note: earn a degree/점수/신뢰(trust) 처럼 '노력해서 얻다'의 뉘앙스. You've earned it = 그럴 만해.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of jewelry that you wear on your ear

examples.en: I lost one earring at the party.
These earrings match your necklace.
examples.ko: 이 귀걸이는 네 목걸이랑 잘 어울려.

senses.note: 보통 복수 earrings, 한 쌍은 a pair of earrings. 한국어 '피어싱'은 영어로 piercing(뚫은 구멍) 또는 그냥 earring.

senses.meaningEn: the planet we live on

examples.en: The Earth goes around the Sun.
There are eight billion people on Earth.

senses.note: 행성 이름일 때는 보통 대문자 Earth, 앞에 the 를 붙이기도 하고 빼기도 함. on earth 는 '도대체'라는 강조 표현(What on earth?).

senses.meaningEn: the soil that plants grow in

examples.en: Cover the seeds with a little earth.
The earth was wet after the rain.
examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤 땅이 젖어 있었어.

senses.note: 흙은 일상적으로 soil, dirt(미)를 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the direction where the sun rises

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
Gangneung is on the east coast.

senses.note: the East Sea(동해), the East Coast(미국 동부 해안). 형용사·부사로도 쓰임(the east side, head east). eastern = 동부의.

senses.meaningEn: not hard to do or understand

examples.en: The test was easy for me.
English is easier than math for her.

senses.note: It's easy to do = ~하기 쉽다. 부사는 easily(쉽게). 비교급 easier, 최상급 easiest (y → i).

senses.meaningEn: relaxed and not worried

examples.en: Take it easy and get some rest.
We had an easy weekend at home.

senses.note: Take it easy. = 진정해/쉬어 가면서 해/잘 가(헤어질 때). easy-going = 성격이 느긋한. Easy! = 조심해, 살살!

senses.meaningEn: very easy to do

examples.en: The test was easy as pie.
Using this app is as easy as pie.
examples.ko: 이 앱 쓰는 건 정말 쉬워.

senses.note: (as) easy as pie. 파이를 만드는 게 아니라 먹는 게 쉽다는 데서 왔다고 함. a piece of cake(식은 죽 먹기)와 같은 뜻. 한국어 '식은 죽' 처럼 음식 비유라는 점이 비슷.

senses.meaningEn: to put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow it

examples.en: What do you want to eat for lunch?
I ate too much at dinner.

senses.note: 과거 ate /eɪt/, 과거분사 eaten. 한국어 '먹다'와 달리 약은 take medicine, 음료는 drink. 국은 eat soup(숟가락으로 먹으므로).

senses.meaningEn: to have a meal

examples.en: Have you eaten yet?
Let's eat out tonight.

senses.note: eat out = 외식하다, eat in = 집에서 먹다. 인사말 '밥 먹었어?'는 Have you eaten? 으로 번역되지만 영어권에선 인사로 잘 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to have a meal in a restaurant instead of at home

examples.en: Let's eat out tonight, I'm too tired to cook.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤은 외식하자, 요리하기엔 너무 피곤해.

examples.en: We ate out three times last week.

senses.note: eat in = 집에서 먹다 / 매장에서 먹다. 식당에서 For here or to go? 는 '매장 식사 vs 포장' 질문. 과거형 ate out.

senses.meaningEn: to eat all of your food

examples.en: Eat up your vegetables, then you can have dessert.
examples.ko: 채소 다 먹어야 디저트 먹을 수 있어.

examples.en: The kids ate up everything on the table.
examples.ko: 아이들이 식탁 위에 있는 걸 다 먹어 치웠어.

senses.note: up 은 '끝까지, 전부' 의 뜻(drink up, clean up 도 같음). 부모가 아이에게 Eat up! = 얼른 다 먹어.

senses.meaningEn: to use a lot of time, money, or space

examples.en: Rent eats up half of my salary.
Traffic ate up most of the morning.
examples.ko: 교통 체증 때문에 아침 시간 대부분이 날아갔어.

senses.note: 한국어 '잡아먹다' 와 똑같은 비유. 주어는 비용·일·앱 등.

senses.meaningEn: a chicken's egg used as food

examples.en: How do you want your eggs, fried or boiled?
examples.ko: 계란 어떻게 해 줄까, 프라이 아니면 삶은 거?

examples.en: I eat two eggs every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 계란 두 개를 먹어.

senses.note: 조리법 표현: fried egg(계란 프라이), boiled egg(삶은 계란), scrambled eggs(스크램블), sunny-side up(한쪽만 익힌 프라이). 한 판은 a dozen eggs(12개) 또는 a carton of eggs.

senses.meaningEn: a round object with a shell that a baby bird or animal grows inside

examples.en: The bird laid three eggs in the nest.
examples.ko: 새가 둥지에 알을 세 개 낳았어.

examples.en: Look, the eggs are starting to hatch!

senses.note: lay an egg = 알을 낳다, hatch = 부화하다.

senses.meaningEn: the number 8

examples.en: My daughter is eight years old.
I usually sleep about eight hours.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 여덟 시간 정도 자.

senses.note: ate(먹었다)와 발음이 같음(/eɪt/). gh 는 소리 나지 않음. 서수는 eighth(8th, /eɪtθ/). eighteen(18), eighty(80).

senses.meaningEn: the number 18

examples.en: You can vote when you turn eighteen.
examples.ko: 열여덟 살이 되면 투표할 수 있어.

examples.en: The ticket costs eighteen dollars.

senses.note: eight + teen 에서 t 가 하나로 합쳐짐(eighteen). 미국·영국에서 18세는 법적 성인이 되는 나이.

senses.meaningEn: the number 80

examples.en: This phone was about eighty dollars.
My grandpa is eighty and very healthy.

senses.note: eight + y 에서 t 가 하나(eighty). 서수는 eightieth(80th). in his eighties = 80대에.

senses.meaningEn: the joint in the middle of your arm where it bends

examples.en: I bumped my elbow on the table.
Don't put your elbows on the table while eating.
examples.ko: 먹을 때 탁자에 팔꿈치 올리지 마.

senses.note: 다리의 무릎(knee)에 대응하는 팔의 관절. 식탁 예절: no elbows on the table.

senses.meaningEn: a very large gray animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk

examples.en: An elephant can drink with its long nose.
examples.ko: 코끼리는 긴 코로 물을 마실 수 있어.

examples.en: The baby elephant stayed close to its mother.
examples.ko: 새끼 코끼리가 어미 곁에 바짝 붙어 있었어.

senses.note: 코끼리의 코는 trunk, 긴 이빨은 tusk. 강세는 첫 음절(/ˈel-/). 중급에서 배우는 the elephant in the room 은 '모두 알지만 말하지 않는 문제'.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that carries people up and down inside a building

examples.en: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.
The elevator is out of order again.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 lift. 엘리베이터를 '타다'는 take/get in the elevator. 에스컬레이터는 escalator.

senses.meaningEn: the number 11

examples.en: The meeting starts at eleven.
A soccer team has eleven players.

senses.note: 11, 12는 -teen 이 붙지 않는 예외. 강세는 두 번째 음절(e-LEV-en). 서수는 eleventh(11th).

senses.meaningEn: a message sent from one computer or phone to another

examples.en: I'll send you an email with the details.
What's your email address?

senses.note: 한 통은 an email, 전체 시스템은 by email(관사 없음). 'Check your email' = 메일함 확인해.

senses.meaningEn: to send someone an email

examples.en: Email me the photos, please.
I emailed the teacher about the homework.

senses.note: email + 사람 + 물건. text 처럼 동사로 바로 씀. '메일하다'보다 email/send an email 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: feeling shy or ashamed in front of other people, often because of a mistake

examples.en: I was so embarrassed when I fell in front of everyone.
Don't be embarrassed. Everyone forgets names sometimes.
examples.ko: 민망해하지 마. 누구나 가끔 이름을 잊어.

senses.note: embarrassed about + 일. 사람은 embarrassed, 민망하게 만드는 상황은 embarrassing. 철자 주의: r 두 개, s 두 개.

senses.meaningEn: having nothing or no one inside

examples.en: The fridge is empty again.
Excuse me, is this seat empty?

senses.note: an empty box/room/street. 빈자리 묻기: Is this seat taken? 도 흔함. 공복에 = on an empty stomach.

senses.meaningEn: to take everything out of something

examples.en: Can you empty the trash, please?
I emptied my bag onto the bed to find my keys.
examples.ko: 열쇠를 찾으려고 가방을 침대에 다 쏟아 냈어.

senses.note: empty the trash/dishwasher/pockets. 과거형 emptied.

senses.meaningEn: to finally be in a situation or place, often one you did not plan

examples.en: We ended up ordering pizza again.
If you don't study, you'll end up failing.
examples.ko: 공부 안 하면 결국 낙제하게 될 거야.

senses.note: end up + -ing / end up + 형용사(end up tired) / end up + 장소(end up in Paris). 계획과 다른 결과일 때 특히 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to arrive at a place you did not plan to go to

examples.en: We took a wrong turn and ended up at the beach.
examples.ko: 길을 잘못 들어서 바닷가에 도착해 버렸어.

examples.en: How did you end up in Korea?

senses.note: How did you end up here? = 어쩌다 여기까지 오게 됐어?(경위를 묻는 표현).

senses.meaningEn: the part of a car, plane, or machine that makes it move

examples.en: Turn off the engine while you wait.
The engine is making a strange noise.

senses.note: start the engine(시동을 걸다), turn off the engine(시동을 끄다). 검색 엔진은 search engine, 소방차는 fire engine.

senses.meaningEn: a person who designs or builds machines, roads, bridges, or software

examples.en: My father is an engineer at a car company.
The engineers fixed the problem in an hour.
examples.ko: 엔지니어들이 한 시간 만에 문제를 고쳤어.

senses.note: software engineer(소프트웨어 개발자), civil engineer(토목 기술자). 강세는 마지막 음절 -neer 에.

senses.meaningEn: a person who drives a train

examples.en: The engineer stopped the train at the station.
The engineer waved to the kids on the platform.

senses.note: 기차 기관사를 미국에서는 engineer, 영국에서는 train driver 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: the language spoken in the UK, the US, and many other countries

examples.en: I study English for an hour every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 한 시간씩 영어를 공부해.

examples.en: How do you say this in English?

senses.note: 항상 대문자 E(English). speak English(관사 없음). in English = 영어로. 영어 수업은 English class.

senses.meaningEn: from or relating to England

examples.en: We had a traditional English breakfast.
My new friend is English, from London.
examples.ko: 내 새 친구는 런던 출신의 영국 사람이야.

senses.note: English 는 '잉글랜드'의. 영국 전체(UK)는 British. 스코틀랜드 사람에게 English 라고 하면 실례.

senses.meaningEn: to get pleasure from something

examples.en: I really enjoyed the concert last night.
Do you enjoy cooking on weekends?

senses.note: enjoy + 명사/-ing(enjoy to cook ✗). 'Enjoy your meal!' = 맛있게 드세요. 'Enjoy!' 한 단어로도 씀. enjoy yourself = 즐겁게 보내다.

senses.meaningEn: as much or as many as you need

examples.en: Do we have enough chairs for everyone?
I didn't have enough money for the bus.

senses.note: 형용사로 쓸 때는 명사 앞(enough money). 발음 /ɪˈnʌf/ — 끝의 gh 는 f 소리.

senses.meaningEn: to the degree that is needed

examples.en: Is the soup warm enough?
He is old enough to drive now.
examples.ko: 그는 이제 운전할 만큼 나이가 됐어.

senses.note: 부사로 쓸 때는 형용사·부사 뒤(warm enough, enough warm ✗). 형용사 + enough + to 동사 패턴을 익힐 것.

senses.meaningEn: as much as is needed, or used to say something should stop

examples.en: That's enough, thank you.
Enough! Stop fighting, you two.

senses.note: That's enough 는 음식 더 받을 때 사양하거나, 아이를 혼낼 때 모두 씀. 억양에 따라 느낌이 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to go or come into a place

examples.en: Please knock before you enter the room.
Only staff can enter this area.
examples.ko: 이 구역은 직원만 들어갈 수 있어요.

senses.note: enter + 장소(enter into the room 은 X). 일상 대화에서는 go in/come in 이 더 자연스럽고, enter 는 안내문·격식체에 많음. 명사 entrance(입구).

senses.meaningEn: to type information into a computer or phone

examples.en: Enter your password and press OK.
I entered the wrong phone number.

senses.note: 키보드의 Enter 키도 여기서 옴. enter a code/password/number. 대회에 참가하다(enter a contest)라는 뜻도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a door or gate where you go into a building or place

examples.en: I'll wait for you at the main entrance.
The entrance to the park is over there.

senses.note: the entrance to + 장소(of 보다 to 가 자연스러움). main entrance(정문), entrance fee(입장료). 지하철역 입구도 entrance 지만 번호를 말할 때는 보통 exit(Exit 2)으로 통일함.

senses.meaningEn: a small piece of rubber used to remove pencil marks

examples.en: I need an eraser to fix this mistake.
Can I use your eraser for a second?

senses.note: 미국식 eraser, 영국식 rubber. 미국에서 rubber 는 전혀 다른 뜻이 되므로 주의. 칠판 지우개도 eraser.

senses.meaningEn: to get away from a place or a dangerous situation

examples.en: Two monkeys escaped from the zoo yesterday.
examples.ko: 어제 원숭이 두 마리가 동물원에서 탈출했어.

examples.en: Everyone escaped from the burning building safely.

senses.note: escape from + 장소. 위험을 "피하다"는 escape (전치사 없이): escape danger. 키보드 Esc 키가 바로 이 단어.

senses.meaningEn: the act of getting away, or a short break from daily life

examples.en: The thief made his escape through the window.
A weekend at the beach is a nice escape.

senses.note: escape room = 방 탈출 게임. fire escape = 화재 비상 계단.

senses.meaningEn: used to show that something is surprising or more than expected

examples.en: Even my little brother can swim.
examples.ko: 내 어린 동생조차 수영할 수 있어.

examples.en: He didn't even say goodbye.

senses.note: 강조하는 말 바로 앞에 둠. not even(~조차 않다). even if(설령 ~라도), even though(~인데도).

senses.meaningEn: used before a comparative to make it stronger

examples.en: Today is even hotter than yesterday.
This one is even cheaper.

senses.note: even + 비교급(even better, even more). very 는 비교급 앞에 못 씀: very better(X) → even better / much better.

senses.meaningEn: able to be divided by two; flat or level

examples.en: Two, four, and six are even numbers.
The floor isn't even, so the table shakes.

senses.note: even number(짝수) ↔ odd number(홀수). 점수가 같을 때도 even: The score is even.

senses.meaningEn: the part of the day from the end of the afternoon until you go to bed

examples.en: We usually eat dinner at seven in the evening.
What are you doing this evening?

senses.note: evening 은 대략 6시~취침 전, night 은 어두운 밤 전체(혹은 잠자는 시간). 만났을 때 인사는 Good evening, 헤어질 때·잘 때 인사는 Good night. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: 저녁 7시 약속을 at night 이라고 하면 어색함 → in the evening.

senses.meaningEn: used to refer to all the people or things in a group, one by one

examples.en: Every student in the class passed the test.
I know every song on this album.

senses.note: every 뒤에는 항상 단수 명사·단수 동사(Every student is...). all 은 복수(All students are...). 셋 이상일 때 쓰고, 둘일 때는 both.

senses.meaningEn: used to say how often something happens

examples.en: I call my mom every Sunday.
The bus comes every ten minutes.

senses.note: every day(매일, 두 단어) 와 everyday(일상의, 형용사) 를 구별할 것. every other day = 이틀에 한 번.

senses.meaningEn: each day, without missing any

examples.en: I drink coffee every day.
She walks her dog every day after work.
examples.ko: 그녀는 퇴근 후 매일 개를 산책시켜.

senses.note: 두 단어로 띄어 쓴 every day 는 부사(매일). 한 단어 everyday 는 형용사(일상적인): everyday life, everyday clothes. 한국 학습자가 가장 자주 섞어 쓰는 철자 중 하나.

senses.meaningEn: used to emphasize that something happens again and again, day after day

examples.en: Every day, my mom asks if I ate.
examples.ko: 엄마는 날마다 내가 밥 먹었는지 물어보셔.

examples.en: The baby grows a little every day.

senses.note: 문장 앞에 두면 '날마다 꼭' 이라는 강조 느낌. every single day = 하루도 안 빼고(더 강조).

senses.meaningEn: on one day, not the next, then again the day after; every second day

examples.en: Take this medicine every other day.
examples.ko: 이 약은 이틀에 한 번 드세요.

examples.en: I go to the gym every other day.

senses.note: every other = '하나 건너 하나'. every other week(격주), every other year(격년)도 같은 방식. every two days 와 뜻이 같음. '다른 날마다' 로 직역하면 안 됨.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Hi, everybody! How are you today?
Everybody loves this song.

senses.note: everyone 과 뜻이 같고 조금 더 구어적. 글에서는 everyone 이 약간 더 흔함. 단수 동사(loves)와 함께 씀.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Everyone is here, so let's start.
Thank you, everyone, for coming today.
examples.ko: 오늘 와 주신 모든 분들, 감사합니다.

senses.note: 뜻은 복수지만 문법은 단수: Everyone is(○) Everyone are(×). every one(띄어쓰기)은 '하나하나 전부'로 다른 말.

senses.meaningEn: all things; each thing

examples.en: Did you pack everything for the trip?
Thank you for everything.

senses.note: 단수 취급: Everything is ready(O), Everything are(X). 안부 확인: Is everything okay?(다 괜찮아?). How's everything?(어떻게 지내?).

senses.meaningEn: in or to every place

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my keys.
examples.ko: 열쇠를 찾으려고 온 데를 다 뒤졌어.

examples.en: There were toys everywhere in the room.
examples.ko: 방 안 곳곳에 장난감이 널려 있었어.

senses.note: 한 단어로 씀(every where X). 전치사 없이 바로: go everywhere(O), go to everywhere(X).

senses.meaningEn: an important test at the end of a course or school year

examples.en: My final exams start next week.
Did you pass your driving exam?

senses.note: examination 의 줄임말. take an exam(시험을 보다), pass/fail an exam. 수능처럼 큰 시험은 exam, 쪽지시험은 quiz.

senses.meaningEn: something that shows what a kind of thing is like

examples.en: Can you give me an example?
examples.ko: 예를 하나 들어 줄 수 있어요?

examples.en: For example, apples and pears are fruit.

senses.note: give an example(예를 들다), for example = 예를 들어(e.g. 로 축약). 'give me a sample' 은 물건의 견본을 달라는 뜻이니 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a person or action that is good and that others should copy

examples.en: Parents should set a good example.
She's a good example for her little brother.

senses.note: set an example = 본보기를 보이다. follow someone's example = ~를 본받다.

senses.meaningEn: very happy and full of energy because something good is going to happen

examples.en: The kids are so excited about the trip.
I'm excited to start my new job on Monday.
examples.ko: 월요일에 새 직장 시작하는 게 기대돼.

senses.note: excited about + 명사 / excited to + 동사. 사람은 excited, 사물·일은 exciting(The game was exciting.). I'm exciting 이라고 하지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: making you feel very happy and full of energy

examples.en: We have some exciting news. We're getting married!
The game was really exciting until the end.

senses.note: exciting(사물이 신나게 하는) vs excited(사람이 신난): I'm so excited! 가 맞고 I'm so exciting! 은 틀림. 영화·여행·소식 등에 자주.

senses.meaningEn: used to politely get attention, apologize, or ask to pass

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
Excuse me, could I get past?

senses.note: Excuse me 는 말 걸기·지나가기·재채기 뒤 등 다양하게 씀. 잘못을 사과할 때는 I'm sorry.

senses.meaningEn: a reason you give to explain why you did something wrong

examples.en: That's a bad excuse for being late.
Stop making excuses and do your homework.

senses.note: 명사는 발음이 /ɪkˈskjuːs/ 로 끝소리가 달라짐. make an excuse = 핑계를 대다.

senses.meaningEn: used politely to get someone's attention or before you ask a question

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Excuse me, is this seat taken?

senses.note: 모르는 사람에게 말을 걸거나 질문하기 전에. 한국어 '저기요' 에 해당. 식당에서 종업원을 부를 때도 Excuse me. Sorry 와 달리 사과가 아님.

senses.meaningKo: (지나가며·잠깐 자리 뜨며) 좀 지나갈게요, 잠시 실례해요
senses.meaningEn: used politely when you need to pass someone or leave for a moment

examples.en: Excuse me, I need to get off here.
Excuse me for a second, I have a call.

senses.note: 사람 사이를 지나갈 때, 자리를 잠깐 비울 때, 기침·트림 뒤에도 Excuse me. 상대가 안 들려서 되물을 때 끝을 올려 'Excuse me?' 하면 '뭐라고요?'. 미국은 excuse me, 영국은 sorry 를 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: physical activity you do to stay healthy

examples.en: I need more exercise. I sit all day.
examples.ko: 운동이 더 필요해. 하루 종일 앉아 있거든.

examples.en: Walking is good exercise for everyone.

senses.note: '운동하다'는 do exercise 또는 exercise(동사). play exercise 는 틀림. 특정 스포츠는 play soccer 처럼 play 를 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to do physical activity to stay healthy

examples.en: I try to exercise every morning.
Do you exercise at the gym or at home?

senses.meaningEn: a short piece of work you do to practice something

examples.en: Do exercises one to five for homework.
This grammar exercise is really hard.
examples.ko: 이 문법 연습 문제 정말 어렵다.

senses.note: 교과서의 '연습 문제'는 exercise. 시험 문제는 question.

senses.meaningEn: a door or way out of a building, a road, or a place

examples.en: Where is the exit?
Meet me at exit three of the subway station.

senses.note: emergency exit(비상구), 지하철 출구 번호는 Exit 3 처럼 말함. 고속도로의 나가는 길도 exit(Take the next exit).

senses.meaningEn: to leave a place, or to close a program on a computer

examples.en: Please exit through the back door.
Click here to exit the app.

senses.note: 동사 exit 은 안내문·컴퓨터 화면에서 주로 보임. 일상 대화에서 '나가다'는 leave/go out 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to think that something will probably happen

examples.en: I expect the bus will be late again.
We didn't expect so many people to come.
examples.ko: 이렇게 많은 사람이 올 줄은 몰랐어.

senses.note: expect + to 동사 / expect + 목적어 + to 동사 / expect (that) 문장. 좋은 일만 뜻하는 hope 와 달리 중립적.

senses.meaningEn: to be waiting for someone or something to arrive

examples.en: I'm expecting a package this afternoon.
Are you expecting someone? The doorbell rang.
examples.ko: 누구 올 사람 있어? 초인종이 울렸어.

senses.note: She's expecting (a baby). = 임신 중이다. 이 뜻도 아주 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to believe that someone should do something

examples.en: The teacher expects us to be on time.
My parents expect too much from me.
examples.ko: 부모님은 나한테 너무 많은 걸 기대하셔.

senses.note: expect a lot of/from 사람 = ~에게 많이 기대하다.

senses.meaningEn: costing a lot of money

examples.en: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
Why are these headphones so expensive?

senses.note: '가격이 비싸다'는 The price is high. 라고 해야 함(expensive price 는 어색). 구어로는 pricey 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to make something clear by giving details about it

examples.en: Can you explain this word to me again?
examples.ko: 이 단어 다시 한 번 설명해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: The teacher explained how to use the past tense.
examples.ko: 선생님이 과거형 쓰는 법을 설명해 주셨어.

senses.note: explain 뒤에 사람을 바로 쓰지 않음 — explain me X(✗) → explain X to me(○). 명사는 explanation. 'That explains it.' = 그래서 그랬구나.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your face that you see with

examples.en: Close your eyes and count to ten.
My eyes are tired from the screen.

senses.note: She has brown eyes. 눈 색을 말할 때는 복수. eye doctor(안과 의사), eye drops(안약).

senses.meaningEn: used in phrases about watching something carefully

examples.en: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
Keep an eye on the kids, please.

senses.note: keep an eye on ~ = ~를 지켜보다, 신경 써서 보다. catch my eye = 눈에 띄다.

senses.meaningEn: the front of your head with your eyes, nose, and mouth

examples.en: Go wash your face before breakfast.
She had a big smile on her face.

senses.note: make a face = 얼굴을 찡그리다. face to face = 얼굴을 마주 보고, 직접.

senses.meaningEn: to have the front toward something

examples.en: My room faces the park.
examples.ko: 내 방은 공원 쪽을 향해 있어.

examples.en: Please face the camera and smile.

senses.note: face the window / face south(남향). 뒤에 to 를 붙이지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to deal with a difficult situation

examples.en: We have to face the problem now.
I can't face another exam this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 시험 하나 더는 못 견디겠어.

senses.note: Let's face it. = 인정하자, 현실을 보자.

senses.meaningEn: meeting someone in person rather than by phone or online

examples.en: I'd rather talk about this face to face.
We finally met face to face last week.

senses.note: 온라인·전화와 대비되는 '대면'. 형용사로는 하이픈: a face-to-face meeting(대면 회의). in person 과 바꿔 쓸 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a building where things are made in large numbers with machines

examples.en: My uncle works at a car factory.
The factory makes about a thousand shoes a day.
examples.ko: 그 공장은 하루에 신발 천 켤레 정도를 만들어.

senses.note: 공장에서 '일하다'는 work at/in a factory. 공장 노동자는 factory worker. 큰 제조 시설은 plant 라고도 함(power plant 발전소).

senses.meaningEn: to drop down to the ground, often by accident

examples.en: Be careful, don't fall on the ice!
He fell off his bike and hurt his knee.

senses.note: fall down(넘어지다), fall off(~에서 떨어지다), fall asleep(잠들다), fall in love(사랑에 빠지다). 불규칙 변화 fall-fell-fallen.

senses.meaningEn: to become lower in number, price, or level

examples.en: Prices usually fall after the holidays.
The temperature fell below zero last night.

senses.meaningEn: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change color

examples.en: I love the colors of fall.
Classes start again in the fall.

senses.note: 미국에서는 fall, 영국에서는 autumn 을 주로 쓴다. 미국에서도 autumn 은 알아듣지만 조금 문어적으로 들림. fall semester = 가을 학기.

senses.meaningEn: to start sleeping

examples.en: I fell asleep on the sofa last night.
The baby usually falls asleep around eight.

senses.note: '잠들다'(동작)는 fall asleep, '자고 있다'(상태)는 be asleep / sleep. 한국인이 'I slept at 11' 이라고 자주 쓰는데, 잠든 시점은 'I fell asleep at 11' 이 자연스러움. 'go to sleep' 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to fail to do something as fast as you should, so you are behind others or behind schedule

examples.en: I was sick for a week and fell behind in math.
Don't fall behind with your homework.

senses.note: fall behind in/with + 과목·일. 반대로 '따라잡다'는 catch up (with). fall behind on the rent(집세가 밀리다).

senses.meaningEn: to move more slowly than others so you are behind them

examples.en: Walk faster, or you'll fall behind the group.
examples.ko: 더 빨리 걸어, 안 그러면 일행에서 뒤처져.

examples.en: Our team fell behind in the second half.

senses.note: 경기 점수에서 뒤지는 것도 fall behind: fell behind 2-0.

senses.meaningEn: to suddenly drop to the ground from a standing position

examples.en: The little boy fell down and started to cry.
Hold the rail so you don't fall down.

senses.note: 사람이 걷다가 넘어질 때 fall down / fall over 둘 다 OK. 계단에서 넘어지면 fall down the stairs.

senses.meaningEn: to break and drop to the ground; to collapse

examples.en: The old wall fell down in the storm.
The picture fell down off the wall last night.

senses.note: 건물이 무너질 때는 collapse 가 더 정확하지만 일상에서는 fall down 으로 충분.

senses.meaningEn: to drop from something you were on or attached to

examples.en: I fell off my bike and hurt my knee.
A button fell off my coat.

senses.note: fall off + 명사(자전거, 의자, 지붕). 뒤에 명사 없이 'The handle fell off.'(손잡이가 떨어졌어) 도 가능. fall down 은 '넘어지다', fall off 는 '위에서 떨어지다'.

senses.meaningEn: to become smaller or lower in amount or quality

examples.en: Sales always fall off after Christmas.
The number of visitors has fallen off this year.

senses.note: 자동사로만 씀. '~을 줄이다'는 cut / reduce.

senses.meaningEn: to fall to the ground from a standing position

examples.en: She slipped on the ice and fell over.
The vase almost fell over when I bumped the table.
examples.ko: 내가 탁자를 치는 바람에 꽃병이 넘어질 뻔했어.

senses.note: 서 있던 것이 옆으로 쓰러지는 느낌. fall over something = ~에 걸려 넘어지다(fall over a chair). 영국에서 특히 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: not true or correct

examples.en: Is the answer true or false?
He gave the police a false name.

senses.note: true/false 퀴즈 = O/X 문제. '잘못된'이란 뜻으로 wrong 이 더 구어적이고 false 는 '사실과 다른·거짓의' 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: not real; made to look real

examples.en: My grandfather wears false teeth.
She put on false eyelashes for the party.
examples.ko: 그녀는 파티를 위해 인조 눈썹을 붙였어.

senses.note: false teeth(틀니), false eyelashes(인조 눈썹), false alarm(잘못된 경보·헛소동). 물건이 '가짜'라고 할 땐 일상에서 fake 를 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who are related, such as parents and their children

examples.en: I have a big family with three brothers.
We eat dinner together as a family.
examples.ko: 우리는 가족이 다 함께 저녁을 먹어.

senses.note: family 는 집합명사. 미국식은 My family is..., 영국식은 My family are... 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: made for or shared by a whole family

examples.en: It's a family movie, so the kids can watch.
examples.ko: 가족 영화라서 아이들도 볼 수 있어.

examples.en: We're going on a family trip this weekend.

senses.note: family dinner, family car, family name(성) 처럼 명사 앞에서 형용사처럼 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: known by many people

examples.en: She is a famous singer in Korea.
This town is famous for its apples.

senses.note: famous for + 유명한 이유. '나쁜 쪽으로 유명한' 은 notorious 를 쓰며, famous 는 보통 좋은 의미. popular(인기 있는)와 구별: 유명하지만 인기 없을 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a machine with blades that turn to move air and keep you cool

examples.en: Turn on the fan, it's so hot in here.
The fan is making a strange noise.

senses.note: electric fan(선풍기), ceiling fan(천장 선풍기). 부채(손으로 흔드는 것)도 fan.

senses.meaningEn: someone who likes a team, singer, or thing very much

examples.en: I'm a big fan of this band.
The fans cheered when the team scored.

senses.note: I'm a big fan of ~ = ~를 정말 좋아해 (사람뿐 아니라 음식·영화에도 씀). I'm not a fan of ~ = ~는 별로 안 좋아해.

senses.meaningEn: a long distance away

examples.en: How far is the airport from here?
Don't go too far from the house.

senses.note: 긍정문에서 'It's far.' 보다 'It's a long way.' 가 더 자연스러움. far 는 주로 의문문·부정문(How far…? / not far)에 씀. 비교급 farther/further, 최상급 farthest/furthest.

senses.meaningEn: very much, used to make a comparison stronger

examples.en: This one is far better than the old one.
The test was far more difficult than I thought.

senses.note: far + 비교급(far better, far more). 'so far' 는 '지금까지', 'by far' 는 '단연코'.

senses.meaningEn: an area of land and buildings where people grow food and keep animals

examples.en: My grandparents live on a farm.
We saw pigs and chickens at the farm.

senses.note: 농장에 산다는 on a farm (in ✗). 농부 = farmer, 농사 = farming.

senses.meaningEn: to grow crops or keep animals on land to make money

examples.en: His family has farmed this land for 100 years.
examples.ko: 그의 가족은 100년 동안 이 땅에서 농사를 지어 왔어.

examples.en: They farm rice and vegetables.

senses.meaningEn: a person who owns or works on a farm

examples.en: My grandfather was a rice farmer.
The farmer feeds the cows every morning.
examples.ko: 농부는 매일 아침 소에게 먹이를 줘.

senses.note: farm(농장) + -er. farmers' market = 농산물 직거래 장터. '농사짓다'는 farm(v.) 또는 grow rice/vegetables.

senses.meaningEn: a style of clothes or hair that is popular at a certain time

examples.en: My sister loves fashion and reads about it every day.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 패션을 좋아해서 매일 관련 글을 읽어.

examples.en: Short hair is in fashion again this year.

senses.note: in fashion = 유행하는, out of fashion = 유행이 지난. fashion show(패션쇼), fashion model(패션모델). 한국어 '패션 감각'은 a sense of style 또는 fashion sense.

senses.meaningEn: moving or able to move quickly

examples.en: He drives a very fast car.
The KTX is the fastest train in Korea.
examples.ko: KTX 는 한국에서 가장 빠른 기차야.

senses.note: fast 는 속도(speed)에, quick 은 짧은 시간에 끝나는 동작에 주로 씀. fast food, a fast runner.

senses.meaningEn: quickly; at high speed

examples.en: You're walking too fast. Slow down!
examples.ko: 너 너무 빨리 걷고 있어. 천천히 가!

examples.en: Time goes so fast when you're having fun.
examples.ko: 재미있게 놀 때는 시간이 정말 빨리 가.

senses.note: 부사도 fast(fastly 는 없음). 'He runs fastly' 는 흔한 실수. 시계가 빨리 가면 My watch is five minutes fast.

senses.meaningEn: hot food like burgers and fries that is served quickly

examples.en: I eat fast food maybe once a week.
examples.ko: 패스트푸드는 일주일에 한 번 정도 먹어.

examples.en: Let's grab some fast food on the way home.
examples.ko: 집에 가는 길에 패스트푸드 좀 사 가자.

senses.note: 불가산명사. a fast food 라고 하지 않음. '패스트푸드점'은 fast food restaurant.

senses.meaningEn: having too much flesh on the body

examples.en: My cat is getting fat because he eats too much.
examples.ko: 우리 고양이는 너무 많이 먹어서 살이 찌고 있어.

examples.en: I feel fat after the holidays.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 fat 이라고 하면 매우 무례하다. 완곡하게는 overweight, heavy, big 을 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: the oily substance in food or under the skin

examples.en: This milk has no fat in it.
Cut the fat off the meat before cooking.
examples.ko: 요리하기 전에 고기에서 기름을 떼어 내.

senses.note: low-fat(저지방), fat-free(무지방). 요리용 기름은 oil.

senses.meaningEn: a male parent

examples.en: My father likes to fish on weekends.
examples.ko: 우리 아버지는 주말에 낚시하는 걸 좋아하셔.

examples.en: His father is a teacher at my school.

senses.note: 격식적·중립적 표현. 직접 부를 때는 Dad. Father's Day = 아버지의 날.

senses.meaningEn: liked more than any other

examples.en: What's your favorite food?
Blue is my favorite color.

senses.note: 이미 최상급 의미이므로 most favorite 라고 하지 않음. 영국식 철자는 favourite. 자기소개·스몰토크에서 가장 많이 쓰는 형용사 중 하나.

senses.meaningEn: the thing or person you like best

examples.en: Of all his songs, this one is my favorite.
examples.ko: 그의 노래 중에서 이게 내가 제일 좋아하는 거야.

examples.en: Grandma's apple pie is a family favorite.
examples.ko: 할머니의 애플파이는 우리 가족이 제일 좋아하는 음식이야.

senses.note: 명사로 쓸 때 my favorite(s) 처럼 소유격과 함께. 웹사이트의 '즐겨찾기' 도 favorites.

senses.meaningEn: the bad feeling you have when you are afraid

examples.en: He has a fear of heights.
The little girl was shaking with fear.
examples.ko: 그 어린 소녀는 두려움에 떨고 있었어.

senses.note: fear of + 명사(~에 대한 공포). a fear of flying/heights/dogs. 형용사는 afraid/scared.

senses.meaningEn: to be afraid of something or worried that something bad will happen

examples.en: Many people fear the dentist.
I fear we'll miss the last train.

senses.note: 동사 fear 는 조금 격식적·문어적. 일상 회화에서는 be afraid of / be scared of 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: one of the soft, light things that cover a bird's body

examples.en: I found a white feather on the beach.
This pillow is filled with soft feathers.
examples.ko: 이 베개는 부드러운 깃털로 채워져 있어.

senses.note: 'as light as a feather' = 깃털처럼 가볍다. 'birds of a feather flock together' = 유유상종. th 는 /ð/ 로 발음.

senses.meaningEn: the second month of the year, with 28 or 29 days

examples.en: February is the shortest month.
We're going skiing in February.

senses.note: 첫 r 을 발음하지 않는 사람이 많아 /ˈfebjueri/ 처럼 들리기도 한다. 철자 Feb-ru-ary 의 r 을 빼먹기 쉬움. 줄임말 Feb.

senses.meaningEn: to give food to an animal

examples.en: Did you feed the cat this morning?
Please don't feed the animals at the zoo.

senses.note: 불규칙 변화: feed – fed – fed. 먹이 자체도 feed(명사)라고 함. 'Give the cat food' 보다 feed the cat 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to give food to a person, especially someone who cannot eat alone

examples.en: I need to feed the baby now.
She fed the kids and put them to bed.

senses.note: 가족을 먹여 살리다 = feed a family. 모유 수유는 breastfeed. 자기가 먹는 건 eat, 남을 먹이는 건 feed.

senses.meaningEn: to give food to a dog

examples.en: Did you feed the dog this morning?
I already fed the dog, so don't give him more.
examples.ko: 개 밥은 이미 줬으니까 더 주지 마.

senses.note: feed + 동물/사람 = 먹이다. 'give food to the dog' 보다 feed the dog 이 훨씬 자연스럽다. 과거형은 fed(feeded 아님). feed the cat / feed the baby / feed the fish 도 같은 패턴.

senses.meaningEn: to experience a particular physical or emotional state

examples.en: I feel sick, so I'm staying home today.
examples.ko: 몸이 안 좋아서 오늘은 집에 있을래.

examples.en: Are you feeling better now?

senses.note: feel + 형용사: feel tired / happy / cold. How do you feel? = 기분·몸 상태 묻기. feel well = 몸이 괜찮다.

senses.meaningEn: to touch something to find out what it is like

examples.en: Feel this blanket, it's so soft.
examples.ko: 이 담요 만져 봐, 정말 부드러워.

examples.en: I felt something move under the bed.
examples.ko: 침대 밑에서 뭔가 움직이는 게 느껴졌어.

senses.meaningEn: to have an opinion about something

examples.en: I feel we should leave a little early.
examples.ko: 조금 일찍 출발해야 할 것 같아.

examples.en: Do you feel this is a good idea?

senses.note: think 보다 부드럽고 개인적인 느낌. I feel like + 절 로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to want to do or have something

examples.en: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
I don't feel like going out today.

senses.note: feel like + -ing / 명사: I feel like a coffee. 직역 '~처럼 느끼다'가 아니라 '~하고 싶다'.

senses.meaningEn: to want to have or do something

examples.en: I feel like pizza tonight.
Do you feel like going for a walk?

senses.note: feel like + 명사/동명사(feel like eating, not 'feel like to eat'). 'I don't feel like it.' = 그럴 기분 아니야.

senses.meaningEn: to seem like something, or to have a particular feeling

examples.en: I feel like I've been here before.
examples.ko: 여기 전에 와 본 것 같은 느낌이야.

examples.en: This blanket feels like real wool.
examples.ko: 이 담요는 진짜 양모 같은 느낌이야.

senses.note: feel like + 문장 = ~인 것 같다(I feel like it's going to rain). 사물이 주어면 촉감이 '~같다'. It feels like home. = 집처럼 편해.

senses.meaningEn: an emotion such as happiness, anger, or sadness

examples.en: I don't want to hurt her feelings.
examples.ko: 그녀의 기분을 상하게 하고 싶지 않아.

examples.en: It's okay to talk about your feelings.

senses.note: hurt someone's feelings(마음을 상하게 하다)는 항상 복수 feelings. No hard feelings. = 섭섭한 마음 없어(화해 표현).

senses.meaningEn: a belief or idea that you cannot fully explain

examples.en: I have a feeling it's going to rain today.
examples.ko: 오늘 비가 올 것 같은 느낌이 들어.

examples.en: I had a bad feeling about that place.

senses.note: have a feeling (that)... = ~일 것 같은 예감이 들다. a good/bad feeling about + 명사.

senses.meaningEn: the ability to feel something in your body, or a physical sensation

examples.en: My legs were so cold I lost feeling in my toes.
examples.ko: 다리가 너무 차가워서 발가락에 감각이 없어졌어.

examples.en: I have a strange feeling in my stomach.

senses.note: lose feeling in + 신체 부위 = 감각을 잃다.

senses.meaningEn: the plural of foot: the parts of your body at the ends of your legs

examples.en: My feet hurt after walking all day.
Please take off your shoes; your feet must be tired.

senses.note: 항상 복수 취급: My feet are cold. (is 아님). 발 하나는 foot.

senses.meaningEn: a big event with music, food, or art that happens for several days

examples.en: There's a food festival downtown this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 시내에서 음식 축제가 있어.

examples.en: We danced all night at the music festival.

senses.note: film festival(영화제), music festival, cherry blossom festival(벚꽃 축제). 한국의 '축제'는 거의 다 festival 로 옮김.

senses.meaningEn: a special day or time when people celebrate something, often religious

examples.en: Chuseok is a big festival in Korea.
Families come together for the festival.

senses.note: 설·추석 같은 명절은 festival 또는 holiday. 일상에서는 holiday 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick

examples.en: The baby has a high fever.
Her fever went down after she took the medicine.
examples.ko: 약을 먹고 나서 그녀의 열이 내렸어.

senses.note: have / run a fever(열이 나다). 열이 내리다 = the fever goes down / breaks. 한국어 '열' 그대로 heat 라고 하지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a small number of people or things, but some

examples.en: I have a few questions for you.
Let's take a break for a few minutes.

senses.note: a few 는 긍정적(조금 있다), few 는 부정적(거의 없다). 셀 수 있는 명사와 씀. 셀 수 없는 명사는 a little.

senses.meaningEn: not many, almost none

examples.en: Few people came to the meeting.
He has few friends at his new school.
examples.ko: 그는 새 학교에 친구가 거의 없어.

senses.note: a 가 빠지면 뜻이 "부족하다"로 바뀜. 구어에서는 not many 를 더 자주 씀(Not many people came).

senses.meaningEn: an open area of land, often used for growing crops or keeping animals

examples.en: Cows are eating grass in the field.
The farmer works in the rice field every day.

senses.note: rice field = 논, wheat field = 밀밭. 꽃이 핀 들판은 a field of flowers.

senses.meaningEn: an area of ground where sports are played

examples.en: The players ran onto the field.
Our school has a big soccer field.

senses.note: soccer/baseball/football field. 농구·테니스는 court, 골프는 course.

senses.meaningEn: a subject or area of work or study

examples.en: What field do you want to work in?
She is an expert in the field of music.

senses.note: in the field of ~ = ~ 분야에서. field trip 은 '현장 학습(소풍)'.

senses.meaningEn: a trip that students take with their class to learn about something outside school

examples.en: We're going on a field trip to the zoo on Friday.
Don't forget your lunch for the field trip.
examples.ko: 현장 학습 갈 때 점심 도시락 잊지 마.

senses.note: go on a field trip = 현장 학습을 가다. 한국의 '소풍·수학여행'을 설명할 때 picnic 보다 field trip / school trip 이 맞음(picnic 은 야외에서 밥 먹는 것). 일상에서 '우리 어디 나갔다 오자'를 농담처럼 field trip 이라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: the number 15

examples.en: Let's take a fifteen-minute break.
The bus comes every fifteen minutes.

senses.note: five 의 v 가 f 로 바뀜(fif-). a quarter = 15분: It's a quarter past three = 3시 15분. fifTEEN vs FIFty 강세 구분.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the fourth one

examples.en: She lives on the fifth floor.
It's the fifth day of our trip.

senses.note: 5th. 철자 주의: five → fifth(v 가 f 로 바뀜). 발음은 /fɪfθ/, 끝의 fθ 가 어렵다면 천천히.

senses.meaningEn: one of five equal parts of something

examples.en: I only finished a fifth of the book.
One fifth of the class was absent.

senses.meaningEn: the number 50

examples.en: Fifty people work at our office.
Can you break a fifty for me?
examples.ko: 50달러짜리 좀 잔돈으로 바꿔 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: fifty-fifty = 반반, 50 대 50. fifty percent = 50%, half 와 같은 뜻. 미국에서 a fifty 는 50달러 지폐.

senses.meaningEn: to hit each other, or to argue angrily

examples.en: The two boys fought over a toy.
My brother and I fight all the time.

senses.note: fight - fought - fought. 몸싸움도, 심한 말다툼도 fight. fight with 사람 / fight over·about 이유. 명사도 fight(have a fight).

senses.meaningEn: to try hard to stop or beat something bad

examples.en: Wash your hands to fight the flu.
She fought cancer for two years and won.
examples.ko: 그녀는 2년 동안 암과 싸워서 이겨 냈어.

senses.note: fight a cold/fire/crime 처럼 '막다, 맞서다'. 응원할 때 한국어 '파이팅!'은 영어로 'Go for it!' / 'You can do it!' — Fighting! 은 콩글리시.

senses.meaningEn: to understand something or find the answer after thinking about it

examples.en: I can't figure out this math problem.
Did you figure out how to use the app?

senses.note: figure out how/what/why + 문장 형태로 자주. 미국 구어에서 매우 흔함. 영국은 work out.

senses.meaningEn: to understand why a person behaves the way they do

examples.en: I just can't figure him out.
examples.ko: 그 사람은 정말 이해가 안 돼.

examples.en: It took me years to figure out my sister.
examples.ko: 언니를 이해하는 데 몇 년이 걸렸어.

senses.note: figure someone out = 사람의 속·성격을 파악하다. 대명사는 중간: figure him out.

senses.meaningEn: to make something full, or to become full

examples.en: Fill the glass with cold water.
The room slowly filled with smoke.

senses.note: fill A with B = A 를 B 로 채우다. 형용사 full(가득한). 배부르다 = I'm full.

senses.meaningEn: to write information in the spaces on a form

examples.en: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
examples.ko: 이 서류를 작성하고 아래에 서명해 주세요.

examples.en: Fill in your name and phone number here.

senses.note: fill out = 서류 전체를 작성(미국식), fill in = 빈칸을 채우다. 둘 다 통용.

senses.meaningEn: to put fuel in a car until the tank is full

examples.en: I need to fill up the car before the trip.
examples.ko: 여행 전에 차에 기름을 가득 넣어야 해.

examples.en: Let's fill up at the next gas station.

senses.note: fill up (the tank). 주유소 직원에게: Fill it up, please. = 가득 넣어 주세요.

senses.meaningEn: to write information in the empty spaces on a form

examples.en: Please fill in your name and phone number.
I filled in the form and handed it over.

senses.note: fill in 은 빈칸 하나하나를 채우는 느낌, fill out 은 서식 전체를 작성하는 느낌(미국식). 둘 다 흔히 통용됨.

senses.meaningEn: to do someone's job for a short time while they are away

examples.en: Can you fill in for me on Saturday?
examples.ko: 토요일에 나 대신 일해 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: A new teacher filled in while Ms. Kim was sick.
examples.ko: 김 선생님이 아픈 동안 새 선생님이 대신 수업했어.

senses.note: fill in for + 사람. 대체 근무자·보결 교사를 말할 때 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone the details they missed

examples.en: I missed the meeting. Can you fill me in?
examples.ko: 회의를 놓쳤어. 무슨 얘기 있었는지 알려 줄래?

examples.en: She filled us in on what happened yesterday.
examples.ko: 그녀가 어제 있었던 일을 우리에게 알려 줬어.

senses.note: fill someone in (on something) 형태. 사람이 동사와 in 사이에 들어감.

senses.meaningEn: to complete a form by writing all the information needed

examples.en: You need to fill out this form first.
I filled out the survey in five minutes.

senses.note: 미국에서 서식 작성에 가장 많이 쓰는 표현. fill out a form / an application / a survey. 입국 신고서도 fill out.

senses.meaningEn: to put as much fuel as possible into a car

examples.en: We need to fill up before the highway.
examples.ko: 고속도로 타기 전에 기름을 넣어야 해.

examples.en: I filled up the tank this morning.

senses.note: 주유소에서 Fill it up, please.(가득 넣어 주세요). 미국식 gas station, 영국식 petrol station.

senses.meaningEn: to eat until you are full, or to make someone full

examples.en: Don't fill up on bread before dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 빵으로 배 채우지 마.

examples.en: That big soup really filled me up.
examples.ko: 그 큰 수프 하나로 배가 정말 찼어.

senses.note: fill up on + 음식(~로 배를 채우다). filling(배부르게 하는) 형용사도 함께 알아 두기.

senses.meaningEn: to become full, or to make a place or container full

examples.en: The room filled up quickly before the show.
examples.ko: 공연 전에 방이 금방 꽉 찼어.

examples.en: Fill up the bottle with cold water, please.

senses.note: 자동사(채워지다)와 타동사(채우다) 둘 다 가능. fill up with + 내용물.

senses.meaningEn: a movie; a story shown in moving pictures

examples.en: We saw a great film last weekend.
examples.ko: 지난 주말에 아주 좋은 영화를 봤어.

examples.en: This film is too long for the kids.

senses.note: 영국식에서 흔히 쓰고, 미국에서는 좀 더 격식 있거나 예술적인 느낌. '영화제'는 film festival 로 미국에서도 film 을 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to record moving pictures with a camera

examples.en: Can you film me while I sing?
examples.ko: 내가 노래하는 동안 영상 찍어 줄래?

examples.en: They filmed the show in Seoul.

senses.note: 사진을 찍는 건 take a picture, 영상을 찍는 건 film / record / shoot. 명사 film 은 옛날 카메라의 '필름'이라는 뜻도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: after a long time or a lot of effort

examples.en: We finally found a parking spot.
You're finally here! We've been waiting.

senses.note: 오래 기다린 끝에 '드디어'. Finally! 하나만으로 '드디어!'라는 리액션이 됨.

senses.meaningEn: used to introduce the last point or step

examples.en: Finally, add some salt and serve.
examples.ko: 마지막으로 소금을 조금 넣고 내면 돼.

examples.en: And finally, don't forget your homework.

senses.note: 순서 설명: First, ... Then, ... Finally, ... 문장 맨 앞에 쉼표와 함께.

senses.meaningEn: to see or get something after looking for it, or by chance

examples.en: I can't find my glasses anywhere.
She found ten dollars on the street.

senses.note: find 는 '찾아낸 결과', look for 는 '찾는 과정'. I'm looking for my keys(찾고 있다) → I found them!(찾았다). 과거형 found 를 '설립하다' found 와 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular feeling or opinion about something after experiencing it

examples.en: I find this book really interesting.
examples.ko: 나는 이 책이 정말 재미있다고 생각해.

examples.en: Did you find the test hard?

senses.note: find + 목적어 + 형용사 = ~가 ...하다고 느끼다. find out(알아내다)은 다른 뜻: I found out the truth. 한국인은 find 와 find out 을 자주 섞어 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to get information about something, or to learn a fact you did not know

examples.en: Can you find out what time the store opens?
examples.ko: 가게가 몇 시에 문 여는지 알아봐 줄래?

examples.en: I just found out that Mina is moving to Busan.
examples.ko: 미나가 부산으로 이사 간다는 걸 방금 알았어.

senses.note: find(찾다)와 달리 find out 은 '정보·사실을 알아내다'. 물건을 찾을 때는 find 만 씀: I found my keys. (not found out). find out about ~ = ~에 대해 알아보다.

senses.meaningEn: to discover that someone has done something wrong or has been hiding something

examples.en: If Mom finds out, we're in big trouble.
examples.ko: 엄마가 알게 되면 우리 큰일 나.

examples.en: He lied, but his boss found him out.

senses.note: find someone out 처럼 사람이 목적어로 오면 '그 사람의 잘못을 알아내다(들키다)'. 수동태 get found out = 들키다.

senses.meaningEn: okay, acceptable, or in good health

examples.en: I'm fine, thanks. How are you?
Is seven o'clock fine with you?

senses.note: That's fine. = 괜찮아요. 말투에 따라 '됐어, 그만해'라는 뉘앙스가 될 수도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: sunny and not raining

examples.en: It's a fine day for a picnic.
The weather will be fine this weekend.

senses.meaningEn: money you must pay for breaking a rule

examples.en: I got a fine for parking here.
The fine for speeding is pretty high.

senses.note: pay a fine = 벌금을 내다.

senses.meaningEn: one of the long thin parts at the end of your hand

examples.en: I cut my finger while cooking.
Don't point your finger at people.

senses.note: 보통 thumb(엄지)은 finger 에 넣지 않아 '손가락 네 개 + 엄지'로 셈. 발가락은 toe(foot finger ×). cross your fingers = 행운을 빌다.

senses.meaningEn: said to hope that something will happen the way you want

examples.en: My interview is tomorrow. Fingers crossed!
I'm keeping my fingers crossed for your test.
examples.ko: 네 시험 잘 보라고 행운을 빌고 있어.

senses.note: 검지와 중지를 꼬는 몸짓에서 온 말. 혼자 "Fingers crossed!" 라고 하거나 keep one's fingers crossed (for ~) 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to complete something you are doing

examples.en: Did you finish your homework?
I'll finish this book tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤에 이 책 다 읽을 거야.

senses.note: finish 뒤에는 -ing: finish eating(먹기를 끝내다). finish to eat 은 틀림. I'm finished. = 다 끝났어.

senses.meaningEn: to eat or drink all of something

examples.en: Finish your vegetables, please.
He finished his coffee and left.

senses.note: Are you finished? 는 식당에서 '다 드셨어요?(접시 치워도 될까요)'의 뜻으로 자주 들림.

senses.meaningEn: to come to an end, or to end a race in a particular place

examples.en: The movie finishes at nine.
She finished second in the race.

senses.note: finish first/second = 1등/2등으로 끝내다. 행사가 끝나는 것은 end 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the heat, light, and flames made when something burns

examples.en: We sat around the fire and talked.
There was a fire in the building last night.

senses.note: 불을 피우다 = make/start a fire, 불을 끄다 = put out a fire. '불이 났다'는 There's a fire! / on fire(불타는 중). 모닥불 = campfire.

senses.meaningEn: to make someone leave their job

examples.en: He was fired last week.
The boss fired two workers for being late.
examples.ko: 사장이 지각 때문에 직원 두 명을 해고했어.

senses.note: 직설적인 표현. 좀 더 부드럽게는 let someone go, 회사 사정으로 자르면 lay off.

senses.meaningEn: the building where fire trucks and firefighters are kept ready

examples.en: The kids visited the fire station on a school trip.
examples.ko: 아이들이 학교 체험 학습으로 소방서에 갔어.

examples.en: Turn left at the fire station.

senses.note: 소방관은 firefighter(fireman 보다 중립적), 소방차는 fire truck(미국)/fire engine(영국). 영국에서는 fire brigade 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people

examples.en: The firefighters put out the fire quickly.
My son wants to be a firefighter.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 소방관이 되고 싶어 해.

senses.note: fireman 보다 성 중립적인 firefighter 가 표준. 소방차는 fire truck(미) / fire engine, 소방서는 fire station.

senses.meaningEn: coming before all others in order or time

examples.en: This is my first time in Korea.
Take the first street on the left.

senses.note: 1st 로 줄여 씀. the first floor 는 미국에서 1층, 영국에서 2층.

senses.meaningEn: before anything or anyone else

examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
Who wants to go first?

senses.note: At first = 처음에는(나중에 바뀜). First of all = 우선 첫째로. first 와 at first 를 혼동하지 말 것.

senses.meaningEn: the name that comes before your family name and that your friends call you

examples.en: My first name is Jiho and my last name is Park.
You can call me by my first name.

senses.note: 영어 이름은 이름이 앞(first), 성이 뒤(last) 라서 first name = 이름. 한국식 순서로 서류를 쓰면 first name 칸에 성을 적는 실수가 많다. 격식 서류에서는 given name 이라고도 함. 영어권에서는 직장 동료도 first name 으로 부르는 게 보통.

senses.meaningEn: used to introduce the first thing in a list of things you want to say

examples.en: First of all, thank you for coming today.
First of all, wash your hands before you eat.

senses.note: 보통 문장 맨 앞에 쉼표와 함께. 뒤에는 second(ly), then, finally 로 이어짐. 상대의 말을 반박할 때 'First of all, I never said that.' 처럼 쓰면 '우선 말해 두는데' 라는 약간 강한 어조.

related: at the end of the day

senses.meaningEn: the meat of a fish, eaten as food

examples.en: I'd like the grilled fish, please.
We eat fish twice a week.
examples.ko: 우리는 일주일에 두 번 생선을 먹어.

senses.note: 음식일 때는 셀 수 없음: some fish, a piece of fish. 한국어는 '물고기'와 '생선'을 구분하지만 영어는 둘 다 fish.

senses.meaningEn: an animal that lives and swims in water

examples.en: Look, there are so many fish in the pond!
My son wants a pet fish.

senses.note: 복수형도 보통 fish: two fish, many fish. fishes 는 여러 '종류'를 말할 때만 가끔 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to try to catch fish

examples.en: My dad fishes every Sunday morning.
We went fishing at the lake last weekend.

senses.note: '낚시하러 가다'는 go fishing. '낚시'라는 취미는 fishing, 낚싯대는 fishing rod.

senses.meaningEn: the sport or job of catching fish

examples.en: My grandfather loves fishing at the lake.
We went fishing but didn't catch anything.
examples.ko: 낚시 갔는데 한 마리도 못 잡았어.

senses.note: go fishing(낚시 가다). 낚싯대는 fishing rod, 낚싯배는 fishing boat. 동사 fish 도 가능(We fished all day).

senses.meaningEn: to be the right size and shape for someone

examples.en: These shoes don't fit me; they're too small.
examples.ko: 이 신발은 나한테 안 맞아, 너무 작아.

examples.en: Does this jacket fit well?

senses.note: fit 은 크기가 맞는 것, suit 는 색·스타일이 어울리는 것, match 는 두 가지가 서로 어울리는 것. 과거형은 미국식 fit, 영국식 fitted.

senses.meaningEn: to be small enough or the right shape to go into a space

examples.en: The box won't fit in the car.
Can we fit one more person in?
examples.ko: 한 명 더 탈 수 있을까?

senses.meaningEn: healthy and strong, especially because you exercise

examples.en: He runs every day to stay fit.
She looks really fit these days.
examples.ko: 그녀 요즘 몸이 정말 좋아 보여.

senses.note: keep/stay fit = 몸 관리를 하다. fitness = 체력, 피트니스. 반대말은 unfit, out of shape.

senses.meaningEn: the number 5

examples.en: Give me five minutes to get ready.
I work from nine to five.

senses.note: 서수는 fifth(5th), fifteen(15), fifty(50)에서는 v 가 f 로 바뀜. high five = 손바닥 마주치기, nine to five = 보통 직장인 근무 시간.

senses.meaningEn: to repair something that is broken or not working

examples.en: Can you fix my bike this weekend?
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 내 자전거 고쳐 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Dad fixed the broken chair yesterday.

senses.note: fix a problem = 문제를 해결하다. repair 보다 구어적. get it fixed = 고치게 하다(남에게 맡겨서).

senses.meaningEn: to prepare food or a drink for someone

examples.en: I'll fix you a sandwich.
Let me fix dinner tonight.

senses.note: 미국 구어. fix dinner / fix a drink / fix someone a snack. 고장 난 걸 고친다는 뜻이 아님에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to repair or improve something, especially a house or a room

examples.en: We're fixing up the old house this summer.
examples.ko: 이번 여름에 그 낡은 집을 손볼 거야.

examples.en: Dad fixed up my bike in an hour.
examples.ko: 아빠가 한 시간 만에 내 자전거를 고쳐 주셨어.

senses.note: fix 만 써도 '고치다'. fix up 은 집·방·낡은 물건을 '손봐서 보기 좋게 만든다'는 느낌이 더 강함.

senses.meaningEn: to arrange a meeting, a date, or a plan for someone

examples.en: Let's fix up a time to meet next week.
I'll fix up a room for you tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 네가 쓸 방을 마련해 줄게.

senses.note: 영국식에서 더 흔함. 미국식 구어에서는 set up 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to arrange for two people to meet because you think they might like each other

examples.en: My sister wants to fix me up with her friend.
examples.ko: 내 여동생이 자기 친구를 나한테 소개해 주고 싶어 해.

examples.en: Stop trying to fix me up with people!
examples.ko: 나한테 사람 소개해 주려고 하는 거 그만해!

senses.note: fix A up with B = A 에게 B 를 소개하다. set up with 와 같은 뜻. 미국 구어에서 자주 들림.

senses.meaningEn: level and smooth, with no high or low parts

examples.en: Put the box on a flat surface.
The land here is very flat.

senses.note: flat shoes(굽 없는 신발), flat screen(평면 화면). 음식에선 flat bread(납작한 빵).

senses.meaningEn: having no air (a tire), no power (a battery), or no bubbles (a drink)

examples.en: We got a flat tire on the highway.
This soda is flat. It has no bubbles.

senses.note: a flat tire = 펑크 난 타이어(미국). 'punk' 는 영어에서 그 뜻이 없음. 영국에서는 배터리가 다 됐을 때 The battery is flat. 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor (British English)

examples.en: They rent a small flat in London.
examples.ko: 그들은 런던에서 작은 아파트를 임대해 살아.

examples.en: My flat is on the third floor.

senses.note: 영국식 flat = 미국식 apartment. 한국의 '아파트'(고층 단지)와 달리 건물 안 한 가구 단위를 가리킴.

senses.meaningEn: to stay on the surface of water and not sink

examples.en: Wood floats, but a stone sinks.
I can float on my back in the pool.
examples.ko: 나는 수영장에서 등을 대고 물에 뜰 수 있어.

senses.note: float(물에 뜨다) ↔ sink(가라앉다). 공중에 떠다닐 때도 쓴다(A balloon floated up into the sky).

senses.meaningEn: a drink with ice cream floating on top

examples.en: I'll have a root beer float, please.
The kids shared a big coke float.
examples.ko: 아이들은 큰 콜라 플로트를 나눠 먹었어.

senses.note: 미국 다이너 메뉴에 흔함. 수영 보조 도구(튜브)를 float 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: the flat surface in a room that you walk on

examples.en: Don't leave your clothes on the floor.
I dropped my phone on the floor.

senses.note: 실내 바닥은 floor, 실외 땅은 ground. '바닥에' 는 on the floor.

senses.meaningEn: a level of a building

examples.en: Our office is on the third floor.
Which floor do you live on?

senses.note: 미국에서 first floor = 1층(한국과 같음). 영국은 ground floor = 1층, first floor = 2층. '층에' 는 on the ~ floor.

senses.meaningEn: (of a liquid) to move smoothly in one direction

examples.en: The river flows through the middle of the city.
examples.ko: 그 강은 도시 한가운데를 흘러 지나가.

examples.en: Tears flowed down her face.

senses.note: flow(흐르다) 와 float(뜨다) 혼동 주의. 교통이 원활히 흐르는 것도 Traffic is flowing well.

senses.meaningEn: the steady movement of something such as water, traffic, or ideas

examples.en: The flow of traffic is slow in the morning.
Don't stop me now, I'm in the flow.

senses.note: go with the flow = 흐름에 맡기다, 분위기 따라가다. 매우 흔한 관용 표현.

senses.meaningEn: the colorful part of a plant that often smells nice

examples.en: He gave me flowers on my birthday.
The flowers in the garden are so pretty.

senses.note: 꽃 한 송이 = a flower, 꽃다발 = a bouquet(of flowers), 꽃집 = flower shop/florist. flower(꽃)와 flour(밀가루)는 발음이 같음. 꽃이 피다 = flowers bloom/come out.

senses.meaningEn: a shop that sells flowers and plants

examples.en: I got these roses at the flower shop nearby.
The flower shop is next to the bakery.

senses.note: 꽃집 주인/플로리스트는 florist, 가게도 florist's 라고 부름. a bunch of flowers(꽃 한 다발), a bouquet(부케).

senses.meaningEn: an illness like a bad cold, with a fever and body aches

examples.en: I think I have the flu. Everything hurts.
examples.ko: 독감 걸린 것 같아. 온몸이 아파.

examples.en: Did you get a flu shot this year?

senses.note: 보통 the flu 로 씀(have / get the flu). 가벼운 감기는 a cold. flu shot = 독감 예방 주사. influenza 의 줄임말.

senses.meaningEn: a thin musical instrument that you hold sideways and blow into

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school band.
The flute has a soft, pretty sound.

senses.note: 한국어 '플룻'이 아니라 flute /fluːt/ — 끝에 t 발음. 플루트 연주자는 flutist(미) / flautist(영). 리코더는 recorder.

senses.meaningEn: to move through the air using wings

examples.en: Look, the birds are flying south.
Penguins are birds, but they can't fly.

senses.note: 불규칙 변화: fly – flew – flown. 3인칭 단수는 flies.

senses.meaningEn: to travel somewhere by plane

examples.en: We're flying to Jeju this weekend.
I flew to Tokyo for the first time.

senses.note: fly to + 목적지. '비행기 타고 가다'를 ride a plane 이라고 하지 않고 fly 라고 함. 비행기는 flight.

senses.meaningEn: a small common insect with two wings

examples.en: There's a fly in my soup!
Shut the door so the flies don't get in.

senses.note: 복수형은 flies. 날벌레는 일상에서 bug 라고 뭉뚱그려 부르기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see

examples.en: There was thick fog on the road this morning.
The fog lifted around noon.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a fog ✗ → thick/heavy fog(짙은 안개). 안개가 걷히다 = the fog lifts/clears. mist 는 더 옅은 안개. fog 와 smog(스모그) 구별.

senses.meaningEn: with thick fog, so it is hard to see

examples.en: It was so foggy that I couldn't see the road.
examples.ko: 안개가 너무 짙어서 길이 안 보였어.

examples.en: Flights were late because of the foggy weather.

senses.note: I don't have the foggiest idea. = 전혀 모르겠다(구어). 비슷한 말 misty 는 안개가 더 얇음.

senses.meaningEn: to bend something such as paper or cloth so one part lies on another

examples.en: Fold the paper in half.
Can you help me fold the laundry?

senses.note: fold the laundry = 빨래를 개다, fold a letter = 편지를 접다. 종이접기 = origami / paper folding. 접이식 = folding: a folding chair.

senses.meaningEn: to cross your arms in front of your chest

examples.en: He folded his arms and waited for an answer.
She sat with her arms folded, looking upset.
examples.ko: 그녀는 팔짱을 끼고 앉아 기분이 안 좋아 보였어.

senses.note: fold/cross your arms = 팔짱 끼기(혼자). 다른 사람과 팔짱 끼는 건 link arms.

senses.meaningEn: to go after or behind someone

examples.en: Follow me, the kitchen is this way.
A small dog followed us all the way home.
examples.ko: 작은 개 한 마리가 집까지 우리를 따라왔어.

senses.note: Follow me. = 따라오세요(안내할 때). 전치사 없이 바로 목적어(follow to me ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to do what rules or instructions tell you to do

examples.en: Please follow the teacher's instructions.
Just follow the recipe step by step.

senses.note: follow the rules / directions / a recipe. 반대는 break the rules.

senses.meaningEn: to understand what someone is explaining

examples.en: Sorry, I don't follow. Can you say that again?
examples.ko: 미안, 이해가 안 돼. 다시 말해 줄래?

examples.en: Are you following the story so far?

senses.note: I don't follow (you). = 못 알아들었어. 수업·설명 중에 자주 쓰는 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to regularly look at someone's posts or news

examples.en: I follow her on Instagram.
Thanks for following my channel!

senses.note: follower = 팔로워. 스포츠 팀·뉴스를 챙겨 본다는 뜻도: I follow baseball.

senses.meaningEn: things that people and animals eat

examples.en: The food at that restaurant is really good.
We need to buy some food for the weekend.
examples.ko: 주말에 먹을 음식을 좀 사야 해.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없는 명사(a food 가 아니라 some food). 종류를 말할 때만 foods(Korean foods). 반려동물 사료는 dog food, cat food.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand on

examples.en: My right foot is a little swollen.
Can you stand on one foot?
examples.ko: 한 발로 서 있을 수 있어?

senses.note: 복수형은 foots 가 아니라 feet.

senses.meaningEn: used in the phrase on foot, meaning by walking

examples.en: We went to the park on foot.
Is the station far on foot?

senses.note: on foot 은 단수. by foot 보다 on foot 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to 12 inches or about 30 centimeters

examples.en: He is about six feet tall.
The room is ten feet wide.

senses.note: 키를 말할 때 six foot two 처럼 단수를 쓰기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: in the US, a game in which two teams carry, throw, and kick an oval ball to score points

examples.en: Americans watch football on Sunday afternoons.
He plays football for his high school.

senses.note: 미국인에게 football 이라고 하면 미식축구(American football). 한국식 축구를 말하려면 미국에서는 soccer 라고 해야 함.

senses.meaningEn: outside the US, the game of soccer

examples.en: In England, everyone talks about football.
Football is the world's favorite sport.

senses.note: 영국·유럽·아시아에서는 축구. 월드컵 관련 기사에서도 football 로 많이 씀. 상대가 어느 나라 사람인지에 따라 뜻이 달라짐.

senses.meaningEn: used to show who gets something or who it is meant to help

examples.en: This gift is for you.
I made dinner for my family.

senses.note: for + 받는 사람. buy/make/cook/get something for someone. give/send 는 to 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: used to say how long something lasts

examples.en: We waited for twenty minutes.
I've known him for five years.

senses.note: for + 기간(for two hours), since + 시작 시점(since 2020), during + 특정 기간 명사(during the summer).

senses.meaningEn: used to show the purpose of something, or the price

examples.en: What's this button for?
I bought these shoes for 30 dollars.

senses.note: What ~ for? = 왜/무슨 용도로? go for a walk(산책하러), for sale(판매 중), for free(무료로).

senses.meaningEn: supporting or agreeing with someone or something

examples.en: I'm for the plan. It sounds good.
examples.ko: 나는 그 계획에 찬성이야. 괜찮은 것 같아.

examples.en: Who are you cheering for?

senses.note: be for = 찬성, be against = 반대. root/cheer for a team = 팀을 응원하다.

senses.meaningEn: for a period of time, not very short and not very long

examples.en: Let's sit here and rest for a while.
I lived in Tokyo for a while when I was a kid.

senses.note: '잠깐' 에서 '몇 년' 까지 길이가 상황에 따라 달라짐. for a little while = 잠시, for a long while = 꽤 오랫동안. 오래 못 본 사람에게 It's been a while. = 오랜만이야.

senses.meaningEn: used to give an example of what you are talking about

examples.en: I like fruit. For example, apples and grapes.
examples.ko: 나는 과일을 좋아해. 예를 들면 사과랑 포도.

examples.en: Some countries, for example Japan, drive on the left.
examples.ko: 일본 같은 몇몇 나라는 좌측 통행을 해.

senses.note: 글에서 약어 e.g. 로 씀. 문장 앞·중간·끝 어디에나 올 수 있고 쉼표로 구분. such as 는 명사 바로 뒤에 붙음: fruit such as apples.

senses.meaningEn: without having to pay any money

examples.en: Kids under five can enter for free.
examples.ko: 5세 미만 아이는 무료로 입장할 수 있어.

examples.en: I got this coffee for free!

senses.note: for free 는 구어. free 만 써도 같은 뜻(get it free). 격식은 free of charge / at no cost. "무료 음료" 는 a free drink(형용사).

senses.meaningEn: for the present time, until something changes later

examples.en: Let's leave the boxes here for now.
That's all for now. See you tomorrow!

senses.note: '일단, 우선은' 처럼 임시라는 느낌이 핵심. at the moment 는 단순히 '지금' 이지만, for now 는 '나중에 달라질 거다' 가 숨어 있음. That's all for now = (방송·수업 끝에) 오늘은 여기까지.

senses.meaningEn: without any doubt; certainly

examples.en: I don't know for sure, but I think so.
She'll be late, that's for sure.

senses.note: know for sure(확실히 알다), That's for sure.(그건 확실해). 격식 글에서는 certainly / definitely.

senses.meaningEn: used to agree strongly or say yes

examples.en: Are you coming to the party? For sure!
Can you help me move? For sure.

senses.meaningEn: a statement about what the weather will be like

examples.en: Did you check the weather forecast?
The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

senses.note: the weather forecast = 일기예보. 예보에 따르면 = according to the forecast. 일기예보를 하는 사람 = weather forecaster/weatherman.

senses.meaningEn: to say what will probably happen in the future

examples.en: They forecast snow for the weekend.
Heavy rain is forecast for tonight.

senses.note: 과거형·과거분사는 forecast(그대로) 또는 forecasted 둘 다 가능. ~이 예보되었다 = ... is forecast (수동태).

senses.meaningEn: from or in a country that is not your own

examples.en: Have you ever lived in a foreign country?
I love trying foreign food when I travel.
examples.ko: 여행할 때 외국 음식 먹어 보는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: g 는 묵음: '포린'. foreign language(외국어), foreigner(외국인). 사람에게 foreigner 라고 직접 부르면 거리감이 느껴질 수 있어 from another country 를 더 쓰는 편.

senses.meaningEn: a large area of land covered with trees

examples.en: Many animals live in the forest.
We got lost in the forest for an hour.
examples.ko: 우리는 숲에서 한 시간 동안 길을 잃었어.

senses.note: forest 는 넓고 깊은 숲, woods 는 그보다 작은 숲. 열대우림은 rainforest.

senses.meaningEn: to not remember something

examples.en: I forgot her phone number.
Don't forget to call your grandma.

senses.note: forget to + 동사 = 할 일을 잊다. 과거 forgot, 과거분사 forgotten. '깜빡했다' = I forgot. / It slipped my mind.

senses.meaningEn: to leave something behind by mistake

examples.en: Oh no, I forgot my umbrella!
He forgot his lunch on the kitchen table.
examples.ko: 그는 도시락을 식탁 위에 두고 갔어.

senses.note: 장소를 말할 때는 forget ✗ → leave: I left my bag at home. (I forgot my bag at home 은 비문법적으로 여기는 경우가 많음).

senses.meaningEn: used to tell someone not to worry about something

examples.en: Forget it. It's not a big deal.
Forget about the test and enjoy the weekend.

senses.note: Forget it. = 신경 쓰지 마 / 됐어. 말투에 따라 '그만해' 식의 짜증으로 들릴 수 있음. forget about + 명사.

senses.meaningEn: to stop being angry with someone who did something wrong

examples.en: Please forgive me. I didn't mean it.
She forgave him for being late.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그가 늦은 걸 용서해 줬어.

senses.note: forgive A for B = B 에 대해 A 를 용서하다. 가볍게 사과를 받아 줄 때는 It's okay / No problem 이 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with a handle and sharp points, used for eating food

examples.en: Can I have a fork, please?
The fork goes on the left side of the plate.

senses.note: a knife and fork 순서로 함께 말함. 포크·나이프·숟가락을 통틀어 silverware(미)·cutlery(영).

senses.meaningEn: a place where a road or path divides into two

examples.en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
We stopped at the fork and checked the map.

senses.meaningEn: the number 40

examples.en: My mom is forty this year.
The train ride takes about forty minutes.

senses.note: 철자 주의: four, fourteen 에는 u 가 있지만 forty 에는 없음(fourty ✗). 서수는 fortieth(40th).

senses.meaningEn: a structure in a park or square that sends water up into the air

examples.en: Let's meet by the fountain in the square.
Kids were throwing coins into the fountain.

senses.note: 분수 '옆/앞'은 by / in front of the fountain. 공공장소의 음수대는 drinking fountain / water fountain.

senses.meaningEn: the number 4

examples.en: We need four chairs for the guests.
The class ends at four.

senses.note: for 와 발음이 같음. 서수는 fourth(4th)지만 forty(40)에는 u 가 없으니 철자 주의. fourteen = 14.

senses.meaningEn: the number 14

examples.en: I'll be on vacation for fourteen days.
She started learning English at fourteen.
examples.ko: 그녀는 열네 살에 영어를 배우기 시작했어.

senses.note: 철자에 u 가 있음(fourteen). forty(40)에는 없음. 발음은 fourTEEN, FORty 로 강세가 다름. two weeks = fourteen days.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the third one

examples.en: My son is in the fourth grade.
Today is the fourth of July.

senses.note: 4th. 미국에서 the Fourth of July = 독립기념일. fourth(4번째)와 forth(앞으로)는 발음이 같으니 철자 주의.

senses.meaningEn: one of four equal parts of something

examples.en: Add a fourth of a cup of sugar.
A fourth of the students were late.

senses.note: 일상에서는 a quarter 를 더 많이 씀(a quarter of an hour = 15분).

senses.meaningEn: a wild animal like a small dog with red-brown fur, a pointed face, and a thick tail

examples.en: A fox ran across the road in front of us.
examples.ko: 여우 한 마리가 우리 앞에서 길을 가로질러 달려갔어.

examples.en: Foxes come out mostly at night.

senses.note: 복수형은 foxes. 여우는 영어에서도 '영리하고 교활한' 이미지(as sly as a fox). 사람에게 fox/foxy 는 '매력적인'이라는 속어이니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: costing no money

examples.en: Kids under five get in free.
The coffee is free with breakfast.

senses.note: for free = 무료로. free of charge 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: not busy

examples.en: Are you free this Saturday?
I'm free after six today.

senses.note: free time = 여가 시간.

senses.meaningEn: not being used by anyone

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
There's a free table by the window.

senses.meaningEn: time when you do not have to work or study

examples.en: What do you do in your free time?
I don't have much free time these days.

senses.note: in my free time(전치사 in). free 는 '무료' 뜻도 있어 free ticket(무료 티켓) 과 혼동 주의. 'What do you do in your free time?' 은 취미를 묻는 가장 흔한 질문. 'Are you free tonight?' = 오늘 밤 시간 돼?

senses.meaningEn: to become hard like ice, or to make food very cold to keep it

examples.en: The lake freezes every winter.
I'll freeze the rest of the soup for later.
examples.ko: 남은 국은 나중에 먹게 냉동해 둘게.

senses.note: frozen food = 냉동식품, freezer = 냉동실. 과거형 froze, 과거분사 frozen.

senses.meaningKo: 너무 춥다, 얼어 죽을 것 같다
senses.meaningEn: to feel extremely cold

examples.en: I'm freezing! Can you close the window?
examples.ko: 얼어 죽겠어! 창문 좀 닫아 줄래?

examples.en: We froze at the bus stop this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침 버스 정류장에서 얼어 죽는 줄 알았어.

senses.note: It's freezing (cold). = 엄청 춥다. 반대로 더울 때는 It's boiling.

senses.meaningEn: to suddenly stop moving or working

examples.en: My computer froze again this morning.
She froze when she saw the big dog.
examples.ko: 그녀는 큰 개를 보고 그 자리에 굳어 버렸어.

senses.note: Freeze! = (경찰이) 꼼짝 마! 화면이 멈추면 The screen froze.

senses.meaningEn: extremely cold

examples.en: It's freezing outside! Close the window.
examples.ko: 밖이 얼어 죽을 만큼 추워! 창문 닫아.

examples.en: My hands are freezing.

senses.note: cold 보다 훨씬 강한 말. 이미 '매우'라는 뜻이 들어 있어서 very freezing ✗ → absolutely freezing ✓. 반대말은 boiling(푹푹 찌는).

senses.meaningEn: the temperature at which water becomes ice, 0°C

examples.en: It will drop below freezing tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 기온이 영하로 떨어질 거야.

examples.en: The temperature is just above freezing.

senses.note: below freezing = 영하, above freezing = 영상. 영하 5도 = five below zero / minus five.

senses.meaningEn: long, thin pieces of potato that are fried in oil

examples.en: Would you like french fries with that?
These french fries are too salty.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 미국에서는 흔히 fries 로 줄여 말함. 영국에서는 chips 라고 하며, 영국의 crisps 가 미국의 chips(감자칩).

senses.meaningEn: recently made, picked, or caught, and not old or frozen

examples.en: The bread is fresh from the oven.
I buy fresh vegetables every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 신선한 채소를 사.

senses.note: fresh fruit / fresh fish / fresh bread. 빵이 오래되어 딱딱해진 것은 stale.

senses.meaningEn: clean and cool, pleasant to breathe or feel

examples.en: Let's open the window for some fresh air.
examples.ko: 창문 열어서 맑은 공기 좀 들이자.

examples.en: I feel fresh after a good night's sleep.

senses.note: get some fresh air = 바람 좀 쐬다. fresh water 는 '민물'(바닷물 salt water 의 반대).

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday

examples.en: See you on Friday night!
We have a test next Friday.
examples.ko: 우리 다음 주 금요일에 시험 있어.

senses.note: 요일 앞에는 on 을 쓴다(on Friday). 요일은 항상 대문자로 시작. Fridays = 매주 금요일. TGIF(Thank God It's Friday)는 '불금'에 가까운 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a refrigerator

examples.en: There's some leftover pizza in the fridge.
Can you grab me a drink from the fridge?
examples.ko: 냉장고에서 마실 것 하나 꺼내 줄래?

senses.note: refrigerator 의 줄임말로 일상 대화에서 훨씬 많이 씀. 철자에 d 가 들어감(frige ✗). in the fridge = 냉장고 '안에'.

senses.meaningEn: cooked in hot oil or fat

examples.en: I'd like fried chicken and a cola, please.
Fried rice is easy to make at home.

senses.note: fried egg(달걀 프라이), fried rice(볶음밥), fried chicken(치킨), French fries(감자튀김). 기름에 푹 담가 튀기면 deep-fried, 살짝 볶으면 stir-fried.

senses.meaningEn: a person you know well and like, who is not family

examples.en: I'm meeting a friend for coffee this afternoon.
examples.ko: 오늘 오후에 친구랑 커피 마시러 만나.

examples.en: She has been my best friend since school.
examples.ko: 그녀는 학교 때부터 내 가장 친한 친구야.

senses.note: make friends = 친구를 사귀다. 나이가 같아야 친구인 한국어와 달리, 영어 friend 는 나이 상관없음. 'i' 가 묵음: /frend/.

senses.meaningEn: a person you are connected with on social media

examples.en: I have about 500 friends on Facebook.
He sent me a friend request yesterday.
examples.ko: 그가 어제 나한테 친구 요청을 보냈어.

senses.note: friend request = 친구 요청. 동사로 friend / unfriend 도 SNS 에서 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: kind and pleasant to other people

examples.en: Everyone in this town is so friendly.
examples.ko: 이 동네 사람들은 다 정말 친절해.

examples.en: Our new neighbor seems friendly.

senses.note: -ly 로 끝나지만 부사가 아니라 형용사! '친절하게 말했다' 는 He spoke in a friendly way. 라고 함. friendly with + 사람 = ~와 친한.

senses.meaningEn: (after a noun) not harmful to or good for the thing mentioned

examples.en: This hotel is very family-friendly.
examples.ko: 이 호텔은 가족 단위 손님에게 아주 좋아.

examples.en: We use eco-friendly shopping bags.

senses.note: user-friendly(쓰기 쉬운), eco-friendly(친환경), kid-friendly(아이들에게 좋은) 처럼 명사+friendly 로 합성어를 만듦.

senses.meaningEn: a small green or brown animal with long back legs that jumps and lives near water

examples.en: We heard frogs singing by the pond at night.
The frog jumped into the water.

senses.note: 개구리는 jump/hop. 두꺼비는 toad, 올챙이는 tadpole. have a frog in your throat = 목이 쉬어 쇳소리가 난다.

senses.meaningEn: used to say where someone or something starts or comes from

examples.en: Where are you from? I'm from Korea.
The train from Busan arrives at noon.

senses.note: I'm from Korea = 한국 사람이에요(출신). come from 도 같은 뜻. from A to B(A에서 B까지).

senses.meaningEn: used to say when something starts

examples.en: The store is open from 10 to 8.
I'll be on vacation from Monday.

senses.note: from Monday(시작점) vs since Monday(그때부터 지금까지, 완료형과 함께). 'from now on' = 이제부터.

senses.meaningEn: used to show who gives or sends something, or what it is made of

examples.en: I got a message from my mom.
This bread is made from rice.

senses.note: a gift from Tom(톰이 준). made from(원료가 변형됨: wine from grapes) vs made of(재질이 보임: a table made of wood).

senses.meaningEn: sometimes, but not regularly or often

examples.en: I still see him from time to time.
From time to time, the printer stops working.

senses.note: once in a while 과 거의 같은 뜻. 문장 앞·뒤 어디에나 놓을 수 있음. 약간 더 글말 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the main door at the front of a house

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the front door.
Leave your shoes by the front door, please.

senses.note: at the front door = 현관문에서. 한국의 '현관'은 보통 front door 또는 entrance 로 표현.

senses.meaningEn: the sweet part of a plant that has seeds, such as an apple or banana

examples.en: I eat fruit every day after lunch.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 점심 후에 과일을 먹어.

examples.en: What's your favorite fruit?

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음: some fruit, a piece of fruit(과일 한 개). 종류를 말할 때만 fruits(tropical fruits). 과일 가게·코너는 fruit section, 과일 샐러드는 fruit salad.

senses.meaningEn: to cook food in hot oil or fat

examples.en: Fry the onions until they turn brown.
I fried two eggs for breakfast.

senses.note: fry 는 기름 요리 전반. 팬에 살짝 볶는 것 stir-fry, 기름에 푹 담가 튀기는 것 deep-fry. 프라이팬은 frying pan.

senses.meaningEn: long thin pieces of fried potato

examples.en: Can I get a burger with fries?
examples.ko: 버거에 감자튀김 추가해 주실 수 있어요?

examples.en: Do you want fries with that?

senses.note: 미국에서는 fries / French fries, 영국에서는 chips. 미국에서 chips 는 감자칩.

senses.meaningEn: having eaten enough and not wanting more food

examples.en: No more cake for me, I'm full.
I'm too full to eat dessert.

senses.note: 식사 후 '배불러요'는 I'm full. 격식 있는 자리에서는 I've had enough, thank you 도 좋다.

senses.meaningEn: containing as much as possible, with no empty space

examples.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
examples.ko: 버스가 꽉 차서 다음 버스를 기다렸어.

examples.en: My bag is full of books.
examples.ko: 내 가방은 책으로 가득 차 있어.

senses.note: full of + 명사 = ~로 가득한. a full glass of water = 물 한 잔 가득.

senses.meaningEn: your first name and last name together

examples.en: Please write your full name on the form.
What's your full name? Just Tom is not enough.

senses.note: 서류·전화 확인에서 자주 묻는 표현. 한국 이름을 영어로 쓸 때 보통 이름 + 성 순서(Minji Kim). 서류의 Full name 칸에는 성과 이름 모두 쓴다. 성만 쓰면 last name/surname.

senses.meaningEn: enjoyment or pleasure

examples.en: We had so much fun at the beach.
Have fun at the party tonight!

senses.note: 불가산 명사: a fun(X), have fun(즐겁게 보내다), for fun(재미로), make fun of(놀리다). 'funny' 는 '웃긴'이라 다름.

senses.meaningEn: enjoyable and pleasant

examples.en: That was a really fun game.
She's a fun person to be around.

senses.note: fun(즐거운) vs funny(웃긴): The trip was fun. / The joke was funny. 한국인은 이 둘을 자주 혼동함.

senses.meaningEn: making you laugh

examples.en: That was the funniest movie I've ever seen.
examples.ko: 그건 내가 본 것 중 가장 웃긴 영화였어.

examples.en: My uncle tells really funny jokes.
examples.ko: 우리 삼촌은 정말 웃긴 농담을 해.

senses.note: 한국어 '재미있다' 는 interesting(흥미로운)과 funny(웃긴) 둘로 갈림. 책이 재미있다 = interesting, 코미디가 재미있다 = funny. fun(즐거운)과도 구별할 것.

senses.meaningEn: strange or unusual, often in a way that worries you

examples.en: This milk smells funny.
It's funny that he didn't call.

senses.note: smell/taste/feel funny = 냄새·맛·느낌이 이상하다. 아프기 시작할 때 I feel funny. 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: the soft, thick hair that covers the body of some animals

examples.en: My cat's fur is so soft.
There's dog fur all over the sofa.

senses.note: 동물 털은 fur 또는 hair, 사람 머리카락은 hair 만 씀. 셀 수 없는 명사라 a fur 라고 하지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: animal skin with the hair on it, used to make clothes

examples.en: She wore a long fur coat in winter.
examples.ko: 그녀는 겨울에 긴 모피 코트를 입었어.

examples.en: Is this fur real or fake?

senses.note: fake fur / faux fur = 인조 모피. 요즘은 진짜 모피에 반대하는 사람이 많으니 대화 시 유의.

senses.meaningEn: an activity you play for fun, with rules, such as a board game or video game

examples.en: Let's play a game after dinner.
My son plays video games every weekend.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 주말마다 비디오 게임을 해.

senses.note: play a game(게임을 하다) — do 를 쓰지 않음. board game(보드게임), card game(카드 게임), video game(비디오 게임).

senses.meaningEn: a sports match between two teams or players

examples.en: Did you watch the baseball game last night?
Our team won the game three to one.

senses.note: 미국에서는 야구·농구·미식축구 경기를 game, 영국에서는 축구 경기를 match 라고 함. win/lose a game.

senses.meaningEn: a building or part of a house where you keep a car

examples.en: Please park the car in the garage.
We keep our bikes in the garage.

senses.note: garage sale = 집에서 안 쓰는 물건을 파는 벼룩시장. parking garage = 주차 건물.

senses.meaningEn: a place where cars are repaired

examples.en: My car is at the garage for repairs.
examples.ko: 내 차는 수리 때문에 정비소에 있어.

examples.en: I took the car to the garage this morning.

senses.note: 미국에서는 정비소를 auto shop / mechanic 이라고도 많이 함. 영국 발음은 /ˈɡærɑːʒ/ 또는 /ˈɡærɪdʒ/.

senses.meaningEn: waste such as food and paper that you throw away

examples.en: The garbage smells really bad today.
Just throw it in the garbage.

senses.note: trash 와 거의 같지만 garbage 는 음식물 쓰레기 느낌이 조금 더 강함. garbage truck(쓰레기차), garbage bag(쓰레기봉투). 셀 수 없는 명사.

senses.meaningEn: an area next to a house where flowers, trees, or grass grow

examples.en: My grandmother has a beautiful garden.
examples.ko: 우리 할머니는 아름다운 정원을 갖고 있어.

examples.en: Let's have lunch out in the garden.

senses.note: 미국에서는 집 옆 잔디밭은 yard, 꽃·채소를 키우는 곳이 garden. 영국에서는 집 뒤 뜰 전체를 garden 이라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of land where you grow vegetables or fruit

examples.en: We grow tomatoes in our vegetable garden.
Dad waters the garden every morning.
examples.ko: 아빠는 매일 아침 텃밭에 물을 주셔.

senses.note: vegetable garden = 텃밭. '정원을 가꾸다'는 동사 garden 또는 do some gardening.
