senses.note: 문장 끝에 단독으로 쓰거나(no matter what), 뒤에 절을 붙임(no matter what you say). no matter how(아무리 ~해도), no matter where(어디든), no matter who(누구든)도 같은 구조. 'It doesn't matter' 와 뜻이 다름에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: no person; not anyone

examples.en: No one came to the meeting.
No one told me about the test.
examples.ko: 시험에 대해 아무도 말해 주지 않았어.

senses.note: nobody 와 같은 뜻, 글에서 조금 더 흔함. 두 단어로 띄어 씀(noone ×). 동사는 긍정형·단수: No one knows.

senses.meaningEn: you have to work hard or suffer to get something good

examples.en: My legs hurt after the gym, but no pain, no gain.
examples.ko: 헬스 후에 다리가 아프지만, 고생 없이 얻는 건 없지.

examples.en: Studying at night is hard. No pain, no gain!
examples.ko: 밤에 공부하는 건 힘들어. 그래도 고생해야 얻는 거야!

senses.note: 운동·공부처럼 힘든 노력을 버틸 때 격려로 쓴다. 보통 쉼표를 넣어 "No pain, no gain." 으로 적는다.

senses.meaningEn: used as a friendly reply when someone thanks you

examples.en: Thanks for your help! — No problem.
No problem. Happy to help anytime.

senses.note: You're welcome 보다 가볍고 친근함. 사과(Sorry!)에 대한 답으로도 씀 = 괜찮아. 격식 있는 자리에서는 You're welcome / My pleasure.

senses.meaningEn: used to say that you can easily do what someone asks

examples.en: Can you send me the file today? — No problem.
examples.ko: 오늘 파일 보내 줄 수 있어? — 문제없어.

examples.en: Getting there by nine is no problem for me.
examples.ko: 아홉 시까지 가는 건 저한텐 문제없어요.

senses.note: 요청을 쉽게 받아들일 때. It's no problem (at all). 로 문장에도 넣어 씀.

senses.meaningKo: 절대 안 돼, 말도 안 돼(거절)
senses.meaningEn: used to say no very strongly

examples.en: Can I borrow your car? No way!
examples.ko: 네 차 좀 빌려도 돼? 절대 안 돼!

examples.en: No way I'm eating that.
examples.ko: 그걸 먹는 건 절대 안 해.

senses.note: 매우 강한 거절·부정. 윗사람·고객에게는 무례할 수 있음. There's no way (that)... = ~할 리가 없다.

senses.meaningEn: used to show that you are very surprised

examples.en: I got the job! No way, congratulations!
examples.ko: 나 취직했어! 말도 안 돼, 축하해!

examples.en: No way! Is that really you?

senses.note: 좋은 소식·나쁜 소식 모두에 쓰는 놀람 표현. 억양을 올려서 말함.

senses.meaningEn: no person; not anyone

examples.en: Nobody answered the phone.
There was nobody in the room.

senses.note: nobody 자체가 부정이라 동사는 긍정형: Nobody knows(○) Nobody doesn't know(×). 단수 동사 사용.

senses.meaningEn: to move your head up and down to say yes or show you understand

examples.en: She nodded and smiled at my idea.
examples.ko: 그녀는 내 생각에 고개를 끄덕이며 웃었어.

examples.en: Just nod if you can hear me.

senses.note: nod (your head) = 끄덕이다(예), shake your head = 가로젓다(아니오). 과거형은 d 를 겹침(nodded). nod off = 꾸벅꾸벅 졸다.

senses.meaningEn: full of or making a lot of unpleasant noise

examples.en: The neighbors upstairs are so noisy at night.
It's too noisy here. Let's find a quieter cafe.
examples.ko: 여기 너무 시끄럽다. 더 조용한 카페 찾아보자.

senses.note: loud 는 단순히 소리가 큰 것, noisy 는 '시끄러워서 거슬리는' 느낌. 명사는 noise(소음). Stop making noise! 도 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a long, thin piece of food made from flour, cooked in water or soup

examples.en: I love spicy noodles on a cold day.
examples.ko: 추운 날엔 매운 국수가 정말 좋아.

examples.en: Do you want noodles or rice with that?

senses.note: 거의 항상 복수형 noodles 로 씀. instant noodles(라면), rice noodles(쌀국수). 한국의 '라면'은 영어로 ramen 또는 instant noodles.

senses.meaningEn: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day

examples.en: Let's meet at noon for lunch.
The store opens at noon on Sundays.

senses.note: at noon(정오에). 12 p.m. 와 같은 뜻이지만 a.m./p.m. 이 헷갈리기 쉬워서 noon 이라고 말하는 게 더 명확하다. 영국식은 midday 도 자주 씀. afternoon(오후)은 noon 뒤의 시간.

senses.meaningEn: usual, typical, and as expected

examples.en: It's normal to feel nervous before a test.
Is this a normal price for a coffee here?

senses.note: It's normal to + 동사 = ~하는 게 정상이다. 사람에게 He's not normal 이라고 하면 무례하게 들릴 수 있음. 명사: get back to normal(정상으로 돌아가다).

senses.meaningEn: at the expected level, with nothing wrong

examples.en: Your temperature is normal. Don't worry.
The doctor said my blood test was normal.
examples.ko: 의사가 내 혈액 검사 결과가 정상이라고 했어.

senses.note: 병원에서 결과를 들을 때 핵심 단어. normal range = 정상 범위. 부사 normally = 보통, 평소에는.

senses.meaningEn: the direction that is on your left when you face the rising sun

examples.en: The mountains are to the north of the city.
My uncle lives in the north of the country.

senses.note: 방향은 to the north of, 지역 안은 in the north of. 형용사 north(north wind), 부사 north(go north)로도 쓰임. northern = 북부의(형용사).

senses.meaningEn: the part of your face that you breathe and smell with

examples.en: I have a runny nose and a cough.
Blow your nose with this tissue.

senses.note: 콧물이 나다 = have a runny nose, 코가 막히다 = have a stuffy nose, 코를 풀다 = blow your nose. 코피 = nosebleed.

senses.meaningEn: used to make a verb or sentence negative

examples.en: I'm not hungry right now.
She does not like spicy food.

senses.note: be·조동사 뒤에 붙임(is not, do not, can not). 구어에선 축약: isn't, don't, can't. 일반동사는 do/does/did + not: I not like(X) → I don't like.

senses.meaningEn: used instead of a whole negative sentence, as in 'I hope not'

examples.en: Is it going to rain? I hope not.
Not me. I didn't break it.

senses.note: I hope not / I think not / Of course not / Not yet(아직) / Not really(별로) — 짧은 대답으로 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: used to emphasize a negative answer; not even a little

examples.en: Are you tired? No, not at all.
I'm not at all hungry right now.
examples.ko: 나 지금 전혀 배 안 고파.

senses.note: No 를 강하게 하는 표현. 문장 안에서는 not ... at all 로 떨어질 수도 있음: I don't like it at all(하나도 안 좋아).

senses.meaningEn: a polite reply to someone who thanks you, meaning it was no trouble

examples.en: Thank you for your help. Not at all.
Thanks for waiting. Oh, not at all.

senses.note: You're welcome 보다 약간 격식 있고 영국식 느낌. 미국에서는 No problem / Sure / You're welcome 이 더 흔함. 'Do you mind if I sit here?' 에 'Not at all.' 로 답하면 '전혀 상관없어요(앉으세요)'.

senses.meaningEn: used to say that something has not happened up to now but probably will

examples.en: Have you finished your homework? Not yet.
Is the bus here? Not yet, it's late.

senses.note: 질문에 짧게 'Not yet.' 으로 답하면 '아직 안 했지만 할 거야' 라는 뜻. 문장 안에서는 haven't ... yet 처럼 끝에 yet 을 둠. 긍정문의 '아직도' 는 still(He is still sleeping).

senses.meaningEn: used to tell someone to wait because it is not the right time

examples.en: Can we open the presents? Not yet, wait for Dad.
examples.ko: 선물 열어도 돼? 아직, 아빠 기다려.

examples.en: Can I eat it now? Not yet, it's too hot.
examples.ko: 지금 먹어도 돼? 아직, 너무 뜨거워.

senses.note: Not yet! 하고 말하면 '지금은 안 돼, 좀 기다려' 라는 가벼운 제지. 아이에게 자주 쓰는 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a book of empty pages for writing notes in

examples.en: Write the new words in your notebook.
I left my notebook at school.

senses.note: 한국어 '노트'는 영어로 notebook. note 는 '메모·쪽지'. take notes = 필기하다.

senses.meaningEn: a small, thin computer you can carry

examples.en: I bought a new notebook for school.
My notebook battery dies too fast.
examples.ko: 내 노트북 배터리가 너무 빨리 죽어.

senses.note: 컴퓨터는 영어에서 보통 laptop 이라고 함. notebook 만 쓰면 공책으로 들릴 수 있으니 notebook computer 또는 laptop 으로.

senses.meaningEn: not anything; no thing

examples.en: There's nothing in the fridge.
What did you say? Nothing, never mind.
examples.ko: 뭐라고 했어? 아니, 아무것도. 신경 쓰지 마.

senses.note: 그 자체가 부정이므로 not 과 함께 쓰지 않음: I know nothing(O), I don't know nothing(X). 고맙다는 말에 It's nothing.(별거 아니에요).

senses.meaningEn: used in 'for nothing' to mean free, or with no result

examples.en: I got these books for nothing at the library sale.
examples.ko: 도서관 세일에서 이 책들을 공짜로 얻었어.

examples.en: We waited an hour for nothing. The shop was closed.
examples.ko: 한 시간 기다렸는데 허탕이었어. 가게가 닫았더라.

senses.note: for nothing = 무료로(= for free) 또는 보람 없이. nothing but(~뿐), nothing special(특별한 거 없어).

senses.meaningEn: to see or become aware of something

examples.en: Did you notice her new haircut?
examples.ko: 그녀가 머리 새로 한 거 봤어?

examples.en: I didn't notice the sign on the door.

senses.note: notice 는 "보려고 해서" 보는 게 아니라 "눈에 들어오는" 것. see/watch 와 구별. 진행형으로 거의 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: a written sign that gives information to people

examples.en: There is a notice on the classroom door.
Read the notice about the school trip.

senses.note: until further notice = 추후 공지가 있을 때까지. give notice = (퇴직 등) 미리 알리다.

senses.meaningEn: the eleventh month of the year

examples.en: Thanksgiving is in late November.
It started snowing in November last year.

senses.note: 줄임말 Nov. 미국 추수감사절(Thanksgiving)은 11월 네 번째 목요일. 발음은 '노벰버'에 가깝게.

senses.meaningEn: at this moment

examples.en: I'm busy right now.
Where are you now?

senses.note: right now = 바로 지금. from now on = 지금부터. for now = 당분간은. 현재진행형(am doing)과 자주 함께 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: used to start a new topic or get attention

examples.en: Now, let's look at page ten.
Now, where did I put my keys?

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 '지금'이 아니라 주의를 끄는 말로, 뒤에 쉼표를 찍고 쉬어 읽는다. now then / now, now 등 다양한 변형이 있음.

senses.meaningEn: sometimes, but not often or regularly

examples.en: I still see my old teacher now and then.
Every now and then we eat out on Friday.

senses.note: every now and then, now and again 도 같은 뜻. sometimes 보다 조금 더 드문 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: not in or to any place

examples.en: There was nowhere to sit on the bus.
examples.ko: 버스에 앉을 자리가 아무 데도 없었어.

examples.en: Where are you going? Nowhere, just for a walk.
examples.ko: 어디 가? 아무 데도, 그냥 산책.

senses.note: 그 자체가 부정이므로 not 과 함께 쓰지 않음: I went nowhere. = I didn't go anywhere. nowhere near(전혀 ~에 가깝지 않다), in the middle of nowhere(외딴 곳).

senses.meaningEn: a word or sign like 1, 2, or 3 that shows how many

examples.en: Pick a number from one to ten.
Seven is my lucky number.

senses.note: number = 수 전체, digit = 한 자리 숫자(0~9). even number = 짝수, odd number = 홀수. 축약형 No. (No. 3 = 3번).

senses.meaningEn: a group of numbers that identifies a phone, room, or house

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
What's your room number?

senses.note: 번호를 말할 때 0 은 oh 또는 zero. wrong number = 잘못 걸린 전화(You have the wrong number.).

senses.meaningEn: an amount of people or things

examples.en: A large number of students were late.
The number of cars is growing every year.

senses.note: a number of + 복수명사(여러 개의) → 복수 동사. the number of + 복수명사(~의 수) → 단수 동사. 시험에 자주 나오는 차이.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to care for sick or injured people, usually in a hospital

examples.en: The nurse checked my temperature and blood pressure.
My aunt works as a nurse at a children's hospital.

senses.note: 남녀 모두 nurse(male nurse 라고 굳이 안 함). 동사로 '간호하다'도 가능. nursing home(요양원).

senses.meaningEn: a dry fruit with a hard shell and a seed inside that you can eat

examples.en: I eat a handful of nuts every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 견과류 한 줌을 먹어.

examples.en: Does this cake have nuts in it?

senses.note: 주로 복수형 nuts. 알레르기를 말할 때 I'm allergic to nuts. 땅콩은 peanut, 호두는 walnut.

senses.meaningEn: (nuts) crazy, or very excited about something

examples.en: Are you nuts? That's so dangerous!
My brother is nuts about soccer.

senses.note: be nuts about ~ = ~에 열광하다. go nuts = 미치다·흥분하다. 친한 사이에서만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: used after a number to say the exact hour

examples.en: Let's meet at six o'clock.
It's already ten o'clock!

senses.note: 정각에만 쓴다. 6:30 은 six thirty 또는 half past six 이고 six thirty o'clock 은 틀림. 원래 of the clock 의 줄임말이라 아포스트로피가 있음. 숫자 뒤에서만 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to do what a person, rule, or law tells you to do

examples.en: The dog obeys every command.
You have to obey the school rules.

senses.note: obey 는 타동사라 전치사 없이 바로 목적어(obey the law, obey your parents). 'obey to' 는 틀림. 규칙은 follow the rules 도 흔히 씀.

senses.meaningEn: one of the very large areas of salt water on the earth

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean.
We watched the sunset over the ocean.
examples.ko: 우리는 바다 위로 지는 해를 바라봤어.

senses.note: 미국 영어에서는 바다를 흔히 the ocean 이라고 함(영국은 the sea). 대양 이름은 the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean.

senses.meaningEn: the tenth month of the year

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.
Halloween is on October 31st.

senses.note: 줄임말 Oct. 날짜를 말할 때는 October thirty-first 처럼 서수로 읽는다. 10월 하면 Halloween 과 단풍(fall colors)이 대표적.

senses.meaningEn: a sea animal with a soft body and eight long arms

examples.en: An octopus has eight arms.
Have you ever tried grilled octopus?

senses.note: 복수형은 octopuses(octopi 도 쓰임). 문어 다리는 arms 또는 tentacles. 낙지·주꾸미도 보통 small octopus 로 설명. 오징어는 squid, 요리명은 calamari.

senses.meaningEn: belonging to or connected with something

examples.en: The door of the car is open.
She's a friend of mine.

senses.note: 사람의 소유는 's(Tom's car), 사물·추상은 of(the top of the hill). a friend of mine = one of my friends.

senses.meaningEn: used after an amount or container to say what it contains

examples.en: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
Most of my friends live in Seoul.

senses.note: a glass of water, a piece of cake, a lot of, some of, one of + 복수명사(one of my friends). 구어에서는 /əv/ 로 약하게 발음.

senses.meaningEn: used to show what something is about or caused by

examples.en: I'm afraid of dogs.
Think of a number from one to ten.

senses.note: be afraid of, be proud of, be tired of, think of, hear of, die of. 형용사·동사와 세트로 외우는 게 효율적.

senses.meaningEn: used to say yes or give permission in a strong, friendly way

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen? — Of course!
examples.ko: 펜 좀 빌릴 수 있어? — 물론이지!

examples.en: Of course you can come with us.

senses.note: Of course not. = 물론 아니지(허락을 묻는 부정 질문에: Do you mind? — Of course not.). 'off course' 로 쓰면 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: used to say that something is obvious or already known

examples.en: Of course it's cold. It's January!
She passed the test, of course. She studied hard.
examples.ko: 물론 그녀는 시험에 붙었어. 열심히 공부했으니까.

senses.note: 상대가 '아는지' 물었을 때 Of course! 라고 답하면 '그걸 왜 물어?' 처럼 들릴 수 있음. 정보 질문엔 Yes, I do. 가 더 안전.

senses.meaningEn: not working or not switched on

examples.en: Please turn off the TV.
Is the heater off? It's cold in here.

senses.note: turn off / switch off(끄다). 상태는 be off: The lights are off.

senses.meaningEn: away from or down from something

examples.en: Take your shoes off at the door.
He fell off his bike yesterday.

senses.note: take off(벗다, 이륙하다), get off the bus(버스에서 내리다), fall off(떨어지다). 반대는 on: put on, get on.

senses.meaningEn: not at work; having free time

examples.en: I have Friday off this week.
She took a day off to see the doctor.
examples.ko: 그녀는 병원에 가느라 하루 휴가를 냈어.

senses.note: a day off(휴가 하루), take ... off(쉬다). 가게의 '할인'도 off: 20% off.

senses.meaningEn: a room or building where people do their work at desks

examples.en: I usually get to the office around nine.
She's not in the office today.

senses.note: '회사에 가다'를 go to the company 라고 하면 어색함. go to the office / go to work 가 자연스러움. 사무실에 '있다'는 in the office, 재택은 work from home.

senses.meaningEn: a place where a particular service is given to the public

examples.en: The post office is open until five.
Go to the main office if you lose your key.

senses.note: post office(우체국), ticket office(매표소), doctor's office(미국식 '병원/진료실'), box office(영화 매표소).

senses.meaningEn: many times; on many occasions

examples.en: How often do you go to the gym?
We often eat out on Fridays.

senses.note: 빈도부사라 보통 일반동사 앞, be동사 뒤에 옴(I often go / I am often late). t는 보통 묵음이지만 /ˈɔːftən/도 흔함. 빈도: always > usually > often > sometimes > never.

senses.meaningEn: used to show surprise or that you have just understood something

examples.en: Oh, I didn't know you were here!
examples.ko: 아, 네가 여기 있는 줄 몰랐어!

examples.en: Oh, now I get it.

senses.note: Oh, I see. = 아, 그렇구나. Oh no! = 이런! Oh really? = 아 진짜? 한국어 '아/어' 와 거의 같은 자리에 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: used before an answer or when you pause to think

examples.en: Oh, about ten minutes, I think.
Oh, by the way, Sam called you.

senses.note: Oh, by the way = 아 그런데(화제 전환). Oh well. = 어쩔 수 없지.

senses.meaningEn: a thick liquid from plants or animals that is used in cooking

examples.en: Heat some oil in the pan first.
examples.ko: 먼저 팬에 기름을 좀 두르고 데워.

examples.en: I use olive oil on my salad.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. cooking oil(식용유), olive oil(올리브유), sesame oil(참기름), vegetable oil(콩기름 등 식물성 기름). 형용사는 oily(기름진).

senses.meaningEn: a thick, dark liquid taken from under the ground, used as fuel or to make machines run smoothly

examples.en: The car needs an oil change soon.
Oil prices went up again this month.
examples.ko: 이번 달에 석유 가격이 또 올랐어.

senses.note: 자동차 '기름(연료)'은 oil 이 아니라 gas(미) / petrol(영). oil 은 엔진오일이나 원유를 뜻함. '기름 넣어야 해' = I need to get gas.

senses.meaningEn: a short written form of okay, meaning fine or acceptable

examples.en: Is it OK if I sit here?
Everything is OK at home.

senses.note: OK, ok, okay 모두 같은 말. 문자·메모에서는 OK/ok, 격식 있는 글에서는 okay 나 fine 을 더 씀. 실제로는 OK 가 가장 흔한 표기.

senses.meaningEn: used to say yes or to agree

examples.en: OK, see you tomorrow!
OK, I'll call you later.

senses.note: 문자 메시지에서 단독으로 OK 만 보내면 차갑게 느껴질 수 있음. OK! 나 Okay, sounds good 처럼 덧붙이면 부드러움.

senses.meaningEn: fine, acceptable, or not hurt

examples.en: Are you okay? You look tired.
The food was okay, but not great.

senses.note: "아주 좋다"가 아니라 "그냥 괜찮다, 무난하다" 정도. Is it okay if I ...? = ~해도 괜찮을까요? (허가 구할 때).

senses.meaningEn: used to agree or to show you understand

examples.en: Okay, let's meet at six.
Okay, I understand now.

senses.note: 대화의 시작·전환·마무리에 모두 쓰는 만능 표현. Okay? 라고 끝을 올리면 "알겠지?" 확인.

senses.meaningEn: having lived for a long time, or used to say someone's age

examples.en: How old is your brother?
My son is five years old.

senses.note: 나이를 말할 때는 ~ years old. 노인을 old people 이라고 하면 무례하게 들릴 수 있어 elderly, older people 을 권함. 반대말은 young.

senses.meaningEn: having existed or been used for a long time

examples.en: These are my old jeans from high school.
examples.ko: 이거 고등학교 때부터 입던 낡은 청바지야.

examples.en: We live in an old house downtown.
examples.ko: 우리는 시내에 있는 오래된 집에 살아.

senses.note: '헌 옷'은 old clothes, 중고는 used. 역사적으로 오래된 건물은 historic 이 더 긍정적.

senses.meaningEn: from an earlier time in your life

examples.en: I met an old friend at the station.
This is my old school.

senses.note: old friend = 늙은 친구가 아니라 '오래된 친구'. my old job(예전 직장), the good old days(좋았던 옛날).

senses.meaningEn: touching the top or surface of something

examples.en: Your phone is on the table.
There's a picture on the wall.

senses.note: 표면에 닿아 있으면 on(벽·바닥·천장도 포함). 떠 있으면 over/above. on the bus/train(타고 있는) vs in the car.

senses.meaningEn: used before days and dates

examples.en: See you on Monday.
The party is on May 5th.

senses.note: on Monday, on the weekend(미국), on my birthday. 월·연도는 in, 시각은 at. 'in Monday' 는 흔한 실수.

senses.meaningEn: working or switched on; being worn

examples.en: Turn on the light, please.
Put your shoes on. We're leaving.

senses.note: turn on/off(전원), put on/take off(옷·신발). The TV is on = 켜져 있다.

senses.meaningEn: using a device or medium; about a subject

examples.en: I saw it on TV last night.
She's on the phone right now.

senses.note: on TV, on the radio, on the internet, on YouTube, on the phone. a book on history = 역사에 관한 책(about 보다 전문적).

senses.meaningEn: by walking, not using a car, bus, or bike

examples.en: I go to school on foot every day.
The museum is ten minutes away on foot.

senses.note: 교통수단은 by car / by bus / by bike 지만 걷기는 on foot(by foot 는 비표준). 구어에서는 그냥 walk 동사를 더 많이 씀: I walk to school.

senses.meaningEn: used to say that you have left and are traveling to a place now

examples.en: Sorry I'm late, I'm on my way!
I'm on my way to the office now.

senses.note: 문자로 OMW 라고 줄여 씀. 주어에 맞게 소유격 변화: She's on her way. / They're on their way. on the way 보다 "내가 출발했다"는 쪽에 초점.

senses.meaningEn: being sold at a lower price than usual

examples.en: These shoes are on sale this week.
I bought the jacket on sale for twenty dollars.

senses.note: on sale = 할인 중(미국). for sale = 팔려고 내놓은(가격과 무관): This house is for sale. 한국인이 자주 혼동함.

senses.meaningEn: used to give a different or opposite point of view

examples.en: The hotel is cheap. On the other hand, it's far away.
I love the city. On the other hand, it's very noisy.
examples.ko: 난 이 도시가 좋아. 다른 한편으론 너무 시끄럽지만.

senses.note: 장점·단점을 나란히 비교할 때 두 번째 쪽 앞에 붙임. on one hand ..., on the other hand ... 로 짝을 이룸. '다른 손에' 로 직역하지 않도록. 비슷한 but 보다 한 박자 느린, 생각하며 말하는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: talking to someone using a telephone

examples.en: Mom is on the phone right now. Wait a minute.
examples.ko: 엄마 지금 통화 중이야. 잠깐 기다려.

examples.en: I talked to my grandma on the phone for an hour.
examples.ko: 할머니랑 한 시간 동안 전화로 얘기했어.

senses.note: be on the phone = 통화 중. talk on the phone = 전화로 이야기하다(by phone 보다 구어적). '전화를 받다' 는 answer the phone, '전화를 걸다' 는 call / phone 동사 사용. 한국어식 'in the phone' 은 틀림.

headword: on the tip of my tongue

senses.meaningKo: (생각이 날 듯 말 듯) 입에서 맴돌다
senses.meaningEn: said when you know a word or name but cannot remember it right now

examples.en: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
examples.ko: 그 사람 이름이 입에서 맴도는데 안 나와.

examples.en: Wait, it's on the tip of my tongue... Paris!
examples.ko: 잠깐, 생각날 듯 말 듯 한데... 파리!

senses.note: 주어는 기억 안 나는 단어·이름(It's / His name is ...). 거의 생각날 듯한 느낌을 말할 때. "I forgot" 보다 생생한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: while going from one place to another

examples.en: Can you buy milk on the way home?
examples.ko: 집에 오는 길에 우유 좀 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: We stopped for lunch on the way to the beach.
examples.ko: 해변 가는 길에 점심 먹으러 들렀어.

senses.note: on the way to + 장소 / on the way home(to 없음). 참고로 in the way 는 "길을 막고 있는": Your bag is in the way.(가방이 길 막고 있어).

senses.meaningEn: already coming and going to arrive soon

examples.en: Your pizza is on the way.
Help is on the way, stay calm.

senses.note: 배달·택배·도움 등이 "출발해서 오는 중" 일 때. 아기가 생겼을 때도 A baby is on the way. 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: at the correct or planned time, not late

examples.en: The train arrived on time this morning.
Please be on time for class tomorrow.
examples.ko: 내일 수업에 늦지 말고 시간 맞춰 와.

senses.note: on time = 정해진 시간에 딱(늦지 않음). in time = 시간 안에(여유 있게, 늦기 전에): We got there in time to see the start. 한국인이 가장 많이 혼동하는 짝.

senses.meaningEn: on the highest part or surface of something

examples.en: Your keys are on top of the fridge.
Put the cherry on top of the cake.

senses.note: on 은 '표면에 닿아 있음', on top of 는 '맨 위에 올려져 있음' 을 강조. 책 더미 위처럼 쌓여 있을 때 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: in addition to something, especially something bad

examples.en: I was late, and on top of that, I forgot my phone.
examples.ko: 늦은 것도 모자라 전화기까지 두고 왔어.

examples.en: On top of homework, I have piano practice today.

senses.note: on top of that = 게다가(주로 안 좋은 일이 겹칠 때). 비슷한 뜻의 besides, in addition 보다 구어적.

senses.meaningEn: being shown on television

examples.en: What's on TV tonight?
I saw my teacher on TV yesterday!

senses.note: TV 방송은 on TV(the 없음), 라디오는 on the radio, 인터넷은 on the internet. 'TV를 보다' 는 watch TV(see TV 아님). What's on? = 지금 무슨 프로그램 해?

senses.meaningEn: one time only

examples.en: I go swimming once a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 한 번 수영을 가.

examples.en: I only met him once.
examples.ko: 그 사람은 딱 한 번 만났어.

senses.note: 횟수: once(1회) → twice(2회) → three times(3회). once a day/week/month = 하루/일주일/한 달에 한 번. one time 도 가능하지만 once 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: at some time in the past, but not now

examples.en: My dad once lived in Busan.
This was once a small village.

senses.note: Once upon a time... = 옛날 옛적에(동화 시작 문구).

senses.meaningEn: as soon as; after something has happened

examples.en: Once you try it, you will love it.
examples.ko: 한번 먹어 보면 분명 좋아할 거야.

examples.en: Call me once you get home.

senses.note: 접속사로 쓰일 때 미래 일이어도 뒤에는 현재형(Once you get home, 미래형 ✗).

senses.meaningEn: sometimes, but not often

examples.en: We eat out once in a while.
Once in a while, I call my grandmother.

senses.note: every once in a while 도 같은 뜻. 빈도: always > usually > often > sometimes ≈ once in a while > rarely > never.

senses.meaningEn: used at the beginning of a children's story to mean a long time ago

examples.en: Once upon a time, there was a little princess.
Once upon a time, a fox lived in the forest.
examples.ko: 옛날 옛날에 여우 한 마리가 숲에 살았어요.

senses.note: 동화의 첫 문장. 뒤에는 there was/lived + 주인공. 일상에서 "옛날에는 ~했지" 라고 농담처럼 말할 때도 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: the number 1

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.ko: 나는 남동생 하나, 여동생 둘이 있어.

examples.en: Let's meet at one o'clock.

senses.note: 서수는 first(1st). one hundred, one thousand 처럼 큰 수 앞에도 붙임. won(이기다의 과거형)과 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: used instead of repeating a noun already mentioned

examples.en: Which one do you want, the red or the blue?
examples.ko: 빨간 거랑 파란 거 중에 어느 걸 원해?

examples.en: This cup is dirty. Can I get a new one?
examples.ko: 이 컵이 더러워요. 새 걸로 받을 수 있을까요?

senses.note: 같은 명사를 반복하지 않으려고 씀. 복수는 ones: I like the blue ones. this one / that one / the other one 이 가장 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: used to talk about a particular time without saying exactly when

examples.en: One day I want to visit Paris.
I saw her at the park one morning.
examples.ko: 어느 날 아침 공원에서 그녀를 봤어.

senses.note: one day 는 과거(어느 날)와 미래(언젠가) 둘 다 가능. someday 는 미래에만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: first one, then the next, separately and in order

examples.en: The teacher called our names one by one.
examples.ko: 선생님이 우리 이름을 한 명씩 불렀어.

examples.en: Put the cups away one by one, please.

senses.note: 한 번에 전부(all at once / all together) 의 반대. 사람·물건 모두에 씀. one at a time 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell and taste

examples.en: Cutting onions always makes me cry.
No onions on my burger, please.

senses.note: 발음은 '어니언' /ˈʌnjən/. green onion = 파, spring onion(영국식).

senses.meaningEn: and nothing or no one else

examples.en: I only have five dollars.
She only eats vegetables.

senses.note: only 의 위치에 따라 뜻이 달라짐: Only I saw him(나만), I only saw him(보기만), I saw only him(그만). 구어에서는 동사 앞에 두는 경우가 많음.

senses.meaningEn: the single one, with no others

examples.en: I'm an only child.
This is the only key we have.

senses.note: 형용사로 쓸 때는 the only / an only 처럼 관사와 함께. only child = 외동(외아들·외동딸 모두).

senses.meaningEn: used to say that a number or age is small

examples.en: It's only seven o'clock. Why are you tired?
My son is only three years old.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 아직 세 살밖에 안 됐어.

senses.note: "겨우, ~밖에"의 느낌. if only(~하기만 하면), not only A but also B 도 함께 익히기.

senses.meaningEn: to move something so it is no longer closed

examples.en: Can you open the window? It's hot.
Open your mouth and say ah.

senses.meaningEn: not closed, or ready for business

examples.en: Is the bank open on Saturdays?
The store is open until ten.

senses.note: '영업 중'은 open, '닫음'은 closed(close 가 아님).

senses.meaningEn: to start talking honestly about your feelings

examples.en: It took him months to open up to me.
examples.ko: 그가 나에게 마음을 열기까지 몇 달이 걸렸어.

examples.en: You can open up. I'm here to listen.

senses.note: open up to + 사람 = ~에게 속마음을 열다. 상담·연애·우정 대화에서 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to start a business, or to open a shop for the day

examples.en: A new cafe opened up near my house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 근처에 새 카페가 문을 열었어.

examples.en: What time do you open up on Sundays?

senses.note: open 과 거의 같지만 open up 은 '새로 생기다·문을 열어 영업을 시작하다'를 강조. 'Open up!' = (문 두드리며) 문 열어!

senses.meaningEn: if a chance or a possibility opens up, it becomes available

examples.en: A new job opened up at my company.
examples.ko: 우리 회사에 새 자리가 하나 생겼어.

examples.en: Learning English opens up a lot of chances.

senses.note: opportunities / chances / jobs open up. 반대로 close down(폐업하다).

senses.meaningEn: used to connect two or more choices

examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?
We can walk or take the bus.

senses.note: A or B? 질문은 끝을 내려 읽음(둘 중 선택). 부정문에서는 and 대신 or: I don't like tea or coffee(둘 다 안 좋아함).

senses.meaningEn: used to say what will happen if something is not done

examples.en: Hurry up, or we'll miss the train.
Wear a coat, or you'll catch a cold.
examples.ko: 코트 입어, 안 그러면 감기 걸려.

senses.note: 명령문 + or + 나쁜 결과 = '~해, 안 그러면 ~'. and 는 좋은 결과, or 는 나쁜 결과로 짝지어 기억.

senses.meaningEn: a round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin

examples.en: Can you peel this orange for me?
I had an orange and some yogurt for breakfast.

senses.note: 모음으로 시작하므로 an orange. 한국어 '귤'은 영어로 mandarin 또는 tangerine. 오렌지 껍질은 orange peel.

senses.meaningEn: having the color between red and yellow

examples.en: She was wearing a bright orange jacket.
examples.ko: 그녀는 밝은 주황색 재킷을 입고 있었어.

examples.en: The sky turned orange at sunset.

senses.note: 명사(주황색)로도 씀: My favorite color is orange. 과일과 색깔이 같은 단어라서 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to ask for food, drink, or goods

examples.en: Are you ready to order?
I ordered a pizza online last night.

senses.note: 식당에서 종업원이 Are you ready to order? 라고 물으면 I'll have... 로 답함.

senses.meaningEn: a request for food or goods

examples.en: Can I take your order?
My order hasn't arrived yet.

senses.note: place an order = 주문하다, take an order = 주문을 받다.

senses.meaningEn: the way things are arranged one after another

examples.en: Put the words in the right order.
The names are in alphabetical order.

senses.note: out of order = 고장 난 (기계에 붙은 안내문).

senses.meaningEn: normal and not special or different in any way

examples.en: It was just an ordinary Monday morning.
He's an ordinary guy who loves soccer.

senses.note: out of the ordinary = 특별한, 색다른. 사람에게 쓰면 '별 특징 없는'이라는 약간 심심한 느낌이 들 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: different from the one already mentioned

examples.en: Do you have this shirt in other colors?
Some people like coffee, other people like tea.
examples.ko: 커피를 좋아하는 사람도 있고, 차를 좋아하는 사람도 있어.

senses.note: other + 복수 명사(other people). 단수 앞에는 another(an + other). "the other" 는 둘 중 나머지 하나.

senses.meaningEn: the second of two people or things, or the remaining ones

examples.en: One sock is here, but where is the other?
examples.ko: 양말 한 짝은 여기 있는데, 나머지 한 짝은 어디 있지?

examples.en: Be kind to others.

senses.note: the other(둘 중 나머지), the others(나머지 전부), others(다른 사람들 일반). 복수 others 에 s 를 붙이는 것은 대명사일 때만.

senses.meaningEn: what you say when you suddenly feel pain

examples.en: Ouch! I hit my head on the door.
Ouch, that needle hurt a little.

senses.note: 한국어 '아야'. 영어권에서는 '아야' 대신 Ouch!/Ow! 라고 함. 철자는 ouch 이지만 발음은 '아우치'.

senses.meaningKo: (남의 말이나 상황이 아플 때) 아이고, 아프겠다
senses.meaningEn: used to show that something is painful, embarrassing, or expensive

examples.en: Fifty dollars for parking? Ouch.
Ouch, that comment was a little harsh.

senses.note: 마음·지갑이 아플 때도 씀. 농담조로 쓰는 경우가 많음.

senses.meaningEn: belonging to the speaker and one or more other people

examples.en: Our teacher is from Canada.
Welcome to our home.

senses.note: 한국어 "우리"는 혼자 말할 때도 쓰지만(우리 집, 우리 회사) 영어 our 는 진짜 둘 이상일 때만. 혼자 살면 my home. hour 와 발음이 비슷함.

senses.meaningEn: away from the inside of a place

examples.en: Let's go out for a walk.
The dog ran out the door.

senses.note: '~의 밖으로'는 out of + 명사: get out of the car. 미국 구어에서는 out the door 처럼 of 를 빼기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: not at home or not at work

examples.en: Mom is out right now. Can I help you?
examples.ko: 엄마는 지금 외출 중이세요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

examples.en: I was out all day yesterday.
examples.ko: 나 어제 하루 종일 밖에 있었어.

senses.note: be out = 집/사무실에 없다. eat out(외식하다), hang out(놀다), go out(데이트하다·놀러 나가다).

senses.meaningEn: used up, finished, or no longer burning or shining

examples.en: We're out of milk again.
The lights went out during the storm.

senses.note: be out of + 명사 = ~이 다 떨어졌다. sold out(품절), go out(불·전기가 나가다), run out(다 쓰다).

senses.meaningEn: old and no longer correct or useful because something newer exists

examples.en: This map is out of date. The road is new.
examples.ko: 이 지도는 오래됐어. 그 길은 새로 난 거야.

examples.en: My phone's apps are all out of date.
examples.ko: 내 폰 앱들이 다 업데이트가 안 됐어.

senses.note: 명사 앞에서는 하이픈: an out-of-date map. 반대는 up to date(최신인). 유통기한이 지난 식품은 out of date(영국) 보다 expired(미국) 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: not working, used about a machine or piece of equipment

examples.en: The elevator is out of order again.
Sorry, this toilet is out of order.
examples.ko: 죄송합니다, 이 화장실은 사용할 수 없습니다.

senses.note: 안내문 OUT OF ORDER 로 자주 보임. 공공 기계(엘리베이터·자판기·화장실) 에 쓰고, 내 휴대폰처럼 개인 물건에는 broken / not working 이 자연스러움. 반대는 in order / working.

senses.meaningEn: not in the correct order

examples.en: These pages are out of order.
The photos are all out of order on my phone.
examples.ko: 내 폰 사진들이 다 순서가 뒤섞여 있어.

senses.note: in order = 순서대로. put them in order = 순서대로 놓다.

senses.meaningEn: not inside a building; in the open air

examples.en: The kids are playing outside in the yard.
It's sunny outside. Let's go for a walk.

senses.meaningEn: not in a particular place, but near it

examples.en: I'll wait for you outside the station.
There's a bus stop right outside the school.
examples.ko: 학교 바로 밖에 버스 정류장이 있어.

senses.note: meet outside the café = 카페 앞에서 만나자. outside of 는 미국 구어.

senses.meaningEn: a closed box in a kitchen that you heat to bake or roast food

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
The cookies are in the oven right now.

senses.note: 발음은 /ˈʌvən/ ('어븐'). put it in the oven, take it out of the oven. 전자레인지는 microwave (oven).

senses.meaningEn: above something without touching it, or across from one side to the other

examples.en: There's a bridge over the river.
The dog jumped over the fence.

senses.note: over = 위에 떠 있거나 덮고 있는 느낌(a blanket over the bed), on 은 접촉. above 는 단순히 '더 높은 위치'.

senses.meaningEn: finished

examples.en: The game is over. We won!
When the movie was over, we went home.

senses.note: be over = 끝나다(상태). It's over between us = 우리 사이는 끝났어. game over 가 바로 이 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: more than a number or amount

examples.en: This movie is for people over 18.
It cost over a hundred dollars.

senses.note: over 18 = 18세 초과. 가격·나이·수량에 두루 사용.

senses.meaningEn: to someone's home, or to a place a little way away

examples.en: Come over for dinner this Saturday.
examples.ko: 이번 토요일 저녁 먹으러 우리 집에 와.

examples.en: Your bag is over there by the door.
examples.ko: 네 가방 저쪽 문 옆에 있어.

senses.note: come over = 놀러 오다, over there = 저기(손으로 가리키며), over here = 여기로.

senses.meaningEn: many times; again and again

examples.en: I listened to the song over and over.
He said sorry over and over again.

senses.note: over and over again 으로 again 을 붙여도 뜻은 같고 더 강조됨. 같은 일이 지겹도록 반복되는 느낌을 담을 때 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a bird with large round eyes that hunts at night

examples.en: An owl was sitting on the tree outside.
examples.ko: 밖에 있는 나무에 부엉이가 앉아 있었어.

examples.en: Owls can see very well in the dark.
examples.ko: 부엉이는 어두운 데서도 아주 잘 봐.

senses.note: night owl = 밤에 활동하는 사람, 야행성 인간(↔ early bird). 부엉이 소리는 hoot. 영어에서 owl 은 '지혜'의 상징(as wise as an owl). 발음은 한 음절 /aʊl/.

senses.meaningEn: to have something that legally belongs to you

examples.en: Do you own this house or rent it?
My uncle owns a small restaurant.

senses.note: have 보다 '법적으로 내 것'이라는 느낌이 강함. 진행형(am owning)으로 쓰지 않음. 명사 owner = 주인.

senses.meaningEn: belonging to the person mentioned and no one else

examples.en: I want my own room.
She made the cake with her own hands.

senses.note: 항상 my/your/his 등 소유격 뒤에 옴(an own room X). on my own = 혼자서, 스스로.

senses.meaningEn: to put things into a bag or box before going somewhere

examples.en: Have you packed for your trip yet?
I packed a lunch for the kids this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 아이들 점심 도시락을 챙겼어.

senses.note: pack a bag/suitcase, pack a lunch(도시락을 싸다). 짐을 풀다 = unpack. 명사 package = 소포.

senses.meaningEn: a group of things sold or wrapped together

examples.en: I bought a pack of gum at the counter.
Can you grab a pack of batteries, too?
examples.ko: 배터리 한 팩도 같이 집어 줄래?

senses.note: a pack of cards(카드 한 세트), a six-pack(6개 묶음). 등에 메는 가방 = backpack.

senses.meaningEn: extremely full of people or things

examples.en: The train was packed this morning.
The café was packed with students.

senses.note: be packed (with 사람). crowded 보다 더 '꽉 찼다'는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: to put your things into bags or boxes before leaving

examples.en: Pack up your things. We're leaving in ten minutes.
We packed up the tent and drove home.

senses.note: pack(짐을 싸다)에 up 이 붙어 '전부 챙겨서 떠날 준비를 하다'. 이사(pack up the house)·캠핑·여행 마지막 날에 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to stop working and put your things away

examples.en: It's six. Let's pack up and go home.
The band packed up after the last song.
examples.ko: 밴드는 마지막 곡을 끝내고 짐을 정리했어.

senses.note: 구어에서 pack up = 일을 마무리하고 자리를 정리하다. 영국 속어로 '(기계가) 고장 나다'라는 뜻도 있음(My car packed up).

senses.meaningEn: one side of a sheet of paper in a book

examples.en: Turn to page 15, everyone.
This book has over 300 pages.

senses.note: 쪽수를 말할 때 page 15 처럼 뒤에 숫자. '페이지를 넘기다'는 turn the page.

senses.meaningEn: a single screen of information on a website

examples.en: The page is not loading.
Go to the home page and click on 'Login'.

senses.note: home page = 사이트 첫 화면. 웹페이지는 web page(띄어 쓰기도 함).

senses.meaningEn: the feeling you have when a part of your body hurts

examples.en: I have a sharp pain in my back.
Is the pain getting better or worse?

senses.note: have / feel a pain in + 신체 부위. be in pain(아파하고 있다). 진통제 = painkiller. 형용사 painful(아픈).

senses.meaningEn: someone or something that is annoying

examples.en: Waiting in line is such a pain.
examples.ko: 줄 서서 기다리는 거 정말 귀찮아.

examples.en: My little brother can be a real pain sometimes.

senses.note: a pain (in the neck) = 귀찮은 사람/일. 친한 사이에서만 쓰는 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to make a picture using paints

examples.en: The kids painted pictures of the sea.
I want to learn to paint flowers.
examples.ko: 꽃 그림 그리는 걸 배우고 싶어.

senses.note: 물감 그림은 paint, 연필·펜 그림은 draw. 그린 그림은 painting, 화가는 painter.

senses.meaningEn: to cover a wall or object with paint

examples.en: We painted the kitchen yellow.
Dad is painting the fence this weekend.

senses.note: paint something + 색깔(paint the wall white). 'Wet paint' 는 '페인트 주의' 안내문.

senses.meaningEn: a colored liquid used for making pictures or covering walls

examples.en: Don't get paint on your clothes.
We need a can of white paint.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 물감 세트는 a set of paints 로 복수 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a person who paints pictures as art

examples.en: Van Gogh is a famous Dutch painter.
The painter sold her picture for a lot of money.
examples.ko: 그 화가는 자기 그림을 큰돈에 팔았어.

senses.note: artist 보다 좁은 뜻으로 '그림 그리는 예술가'. 그림 작품은 painting.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to paint walls and buildings

examples.en: The painters are coming to do the kitchen tomorrow.
examples.ko: 내일 도장공들이 와서 주방 칠할 거야.

examples.en: We hired a painter for the outside of the house.

senses.note: house painter 라고 하면 뜻이 분명해짐. 상황에 따라 화가인지 도장공인지 구별.

senses.meaningEn: two things of the same kind that are used together

examples.en: I bought a new pair of shoes.
Do you have a pair of scissors?

senses.note: a pair of + 복수명사. shoes, socks, gloves(두 개로 된 것)와 jeans, pants, glasses, scissors(하나지만 두 부분으로 된 것) 모두 pair 로 센다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: a pants (X) → a pair of pants (O).

senses.meaningEn: two people who are together or do something together

examples.en: Work in pairs and talk about your weekend.
examples.ko: 둘씩 짝을 지어 주말에 대해 이야기해 보세요.

examples.en: The two of them make a nice pair.

senses.note: in pairs = 둘씩. 교실에서 pair work(짝 활동)라는 표현을 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a very large, grand house where a king, queen, or president lives

examples.en: We visited an old palace in Seoul.
examples.ko: 우리는 서울에 있는 옛 궁궐을 방문했어.

examples.en: The king lived in this palace for forty years.

senses.note: 경복궁은 Gyeongbokgung Palace. palace 는 왕이 '사는' 호화로운 집, castle 은 적을 막기 위한 성(방어용). 발음은 /ˈpæləs/ 로 '팰리스'.

senses.meaningEn: a large black and white animal like a bear that lives in China and eats bamboo

examples.en: The pandas at the zoo were eating bamboo.
My daughter has a panda on her backpack.
examples.ko: 우리 딸 가방에 판다 그림이 있어.

senses.note: giant panda(자이언트 판다)가 정식 이름. 대나무는 bamboo. 한국의 '푸바오'처럼 판다는 아이들 대화에 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing that covers the legs, with a separate part for each leg

examples.en: These pants are a little long for me.
He put on his pants and a sweater.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 한 벌은 a pair of pants. 영국에서 pants 는 '속옷'이고 바지는 trousers 이니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: thin material that you write or draw on

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Write your name at the top of the paper.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '종이 한 장'은 a paper ✗ → a piece of paper / a sheet of paper.

senses.meaningEn: a test, or a piece of writing done for school

examples.en: I have to write a paper for history class.
The teacher handed back our papers today.

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 셀 수 있는 명사(a paper, papers).

senses.meaningEn: a newspaper

examples.en: My dad reads the paper every morning.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠는 매일 아침 신문을 읽으셔.

examples.en: Did you see the story in today's paper?

senses.note: 구어에서 newspaper 를 줄여 the paper 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a person's mother or father

examples.en: My parents live in a small town.
Every parent wants the best for their child.
examples.ko: 모든 부모는 자식에게 가장 좋은 걸 바라지.

senses.note: 한 명이면 parent, 두 분이면 parents. 한국어 '부모님'을 말할 때 대부분 복수 parents 를 써야 함.

senses.meaningEn: the mother or father of a student, in relation to the school

examples.en: Parents are invited to the school meeting on Friday.
The teacher called my parents last night.

senses.note: parent-teacher meeting = 학부모 상담.

senses.meaningEn: a large open area with grass and trees where people can walk and relax

examples.en: Let's have lunch in the park.
The kids are playing at the park.

senses.note: 놀이공원은 amusement park / theme park, 국립공원은 national park. 주차장은 parking lot(미국).

senses.meaningEn: to stop a car and leave it somewhere for a while

examples.en: Where did you park the car?
You can't park here. It's a bus stop.
examples.ko: 여기 주차하면 안 돼. 버스 정류장이야.

senses.note: 주차 = parking(명사). '파킹하다'를 do parking 이라고 하지 않고 동사 park 로 말함. 'No parking' = 주차 금지.

senses.meaningEn: an open area where people can leave their cars

examples.en: The parking lot was full, so we parked on the street.
I'll meet you in the parking lot behind the mall.

senses.note: 미국식 parking lot, 영국식 car park. 건물형 주차장은 parking garage. 한국식 '파킹'만 말하면 안 통함. 주차 공간 하나는 parking space/spot.

senses.meaningEn: a colorful bird that can copy human speech

examples.en: My uncle has a parrot that says hello.
The parrot has green and red feathers.
examples.ko: 그 앵무새는 초록색과 빨간색 깃털이 있어.

senses.note: 동사로 쓰면 '뜻도 모르고 따라 말하다'(parrot what someone says). 발음은 /ˈpærət/ — 'carrot'과 라임.

senses.meaningEn: the person you do an activity or game with

examples.en: Find a partner and practice the dialogue.
My partner and I won the game.

senses.meaningEn: the person you are married to or in a long relationship with

examples.en: She came to the party with her partner.
You can bring your partner to the dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 식사에 배우자나 연인을 데려와도 돼.

senses.note: 결혼 여부·성별을 밝히지 않고 연인/배우자를 말할 때 두루 쓰는 중립적인 단어. husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend 를 모를 때 안전함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who owns a business together with someone else

examples.en: He and his business partner opened a café.
The two partners share the work.

senses.meaningEn: a social event where people meet to eat, drink, talk, and have fun

examples.en: Are you coming to my birthday party?
We had a small party at home last night.

senses.note: have/throw a party(파티를 열다), go to a party. 한국어 '회식'은 party 가 아니라 company dinner / team dinner.

senses.meaningEn: a political group that tries to win elections

examples.en: Which party won the election?
My uncle works for a political party.

senses.note: political party. 뉴스에서 자주 들리는 뜻. 파티와 전혀 다른 의미이니 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to give something to someone by handing it over

examples.en: Could you pass the salt, please?
Pass me my phone, will you?

senses.note: 식탁에서 가장 많이 쓰는 표현. pass + 사람 + 물건 순서.

senses.meaningEn: to succeed in a test or exam

examples.en: I passed my driving test!
Did everyone pass the exam?

senses.note: pass the exam = 합격. '시험을 보다'는 take the exam.

senses.meaningEn: to go past something or someone

examples.en: We passed a small lake on the way.
The bus passes right by my house.
examples.ko: 그 버스는 우리 집 바로 앞을 지나가.

senses.note: pass by = 지나가다. 시간이 '지나다'도 pass(Time passes quickly).

senses.meaningEn: to die (a gentle, polite way to say it)

examples.en: My grandfather passed away last spring.
I'm so sorry to hear that your dog passed away.

senses.note: die 를 직접 말하기 어려울 때 쓰는 완곡 표현. 한국어 '돌아가시다'에 해당. 위로할 때: I'm sorry for your loss.

senses.meaningEn: to go past a person or place without stopping

examples.en: I pass by your office every morning.
examples.ko: 매일 아침 네 사무실 옆을 지나가.

examples.en: A bus passed by, but it didn't stop.
examples.ko: 버스 한 대가 지나갔지만 서지 않았어.

senses.note: pass by + 장소, 또는 목적어 없이 pass by. 명사 passerby(지나가는 사람, 복수 passersby). drop by(잠깐 들르다) 와 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: (of time) to go past

examples.en: The summer passed by so quickly.
Years passed by, and we lost touch.
examples.ko: 여러 해가 흐르고, 우리는 연락이 끊겼어.

senses.note: go by 와 같음. '기회를 놓치다'는 let the chance pass by.

senses.meaningEn: to give information or a message to someone else

examples.en: Could you pass on the message to Sarah?
I'll pass your thanks on to the team.

senses.note: pass on + 내용 + to + 사람. 물건을 '건네주다'는 pass. 감기 같은 병을 '옮기다'도 pass on(pass on a cold).

senses.meaningEn: to say no to something that is offered to you

examples.en: I'll pass on dessert. I'm full.
Thanks, but I think I'll pass on the party tonight.
examples.ko: 고마운데, 오늘 밤 파티는 빠질까 봐.

senses.note: 'I'll pass.' 만 써도 됨. 한국어 '패스할게'와 같은 느낌. pass away(죽다) 의 완곡 표현으로 pass on 을 쓰기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to suddenly become unconscious

examples.en: It was so hot that two runners passed out.
examples.ko: 너무 더워서 주자 두 명이 기절했어.

examples.en: I almost passed out when I saw the blood.

senses.note: faint 의 구어 표현. 술 마시고 '뻗다'도 pass out. 깨어나는 것은 come to / come around.

senses.meaningEn: to give something to each person in a group

examples.en: Could you pass out these worksheets, please?
The teacher passed out the test papers.

senses.note: hand out 과 같은 뜻. 교실에서 아주 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not driving it

examples.en: All passengers must wear a seat belt.
The bus was full of passengers.

senses.note: 운전하지 않고 타는 사람 전부. passenger seat = (차의) 조수석. 비행기 안내 방송에서 'Attention, passengers.' 로 시작하는 경우가 많음.

senses.meaningEn: an official document with your photo that you need to enter other countries

examples.en: Don't forget your passport!
May I see your passport, please?

senses.note: 공항에서 passport control(출입국 심사). 여권을 만들다 = get a passport, 갱신하다 = renew. 비자(visa)와 구분.

senses.meaningEn: after a particular hour on the clock

examples.en: It's ten past eight.
The kids went to bed at half past nine.

senses.note: 분이 30 이하일 때 '분 past 시' 로 말한다(twenty past six = 6:20). 30 이 넘으면 to 를 쓴다(twenty to seven = 6:40). 미국식은 after 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: moving by or beyond a place

examples.en: Walk past the bank and turn left.
A bus just drove past us.
examples.ko: 버스 한 대가 방금 우리 옆을 지나갔어.

senses.note: go past / walk past / drive past 처럼 이동 동사와 짝을 이룬다. 동사 pass 의 과거형 passed 와 발음이 같아 글에서 헷갈리기 쉬움.

senses.meaningEn: the time before now

examples.en: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
Let's forget the past and start again.

senses.note: the past(과거), the present(현재), the future(미래). 형용사로도 쓴다: the past week(지난 한 주), past tense(과거 시제).

senses.meaningEn: an Italian food made from flour and water, such as spaghetti

examples.en: I'm making pasta for dinner tonight.
This pasta needs more sauce.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: pastas (×), a pasta (×) → a plate of pasta, some pasta. spaghetti, penne, macaroni 가 모두 pasta 의 종류.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is getting medical care from a doctor

examples.en: The doctor sees about thirty patients a day.
examples.ko: 그 의사는 하루에 환자 30명 정도를 봐.

examples.en: Patients must wait here until their name is called.
examples.ko: 환자는 이름이 불릴 때까지 여기서 기다려야 해요.

senses.meaningEn: able to wait calmly without getting angry

examples.en: Please be patient. The bus will come soon.
examples.ko: 조금만 참아. 버스 곧 올 거야.

examples.en: My teacher is very patient with us.
examples.ko: 우리 선생님은 우리에게 아주 참을성이 많으셔.

senses.note: 명사 '환자'와 형용사 '참을성 있는'이 같은 철자. be patient with + 사람. 명사형 patience(인내).

senses.meaningEn: the foot of an animal such as a dog, cat, or bear

examples.en: The puppy put its paw on my knee.
Wipe the dog's paws before he comes in.
examples.ko: 개 들어오기 전에 발 닦아 줘.

senses.note: 개·고양이·곰처럼 발톱 있는 동물의 발. 말·소의 발은 hoof. 강아지에게 '손!' 하는 명령은 Shake! 또는 Paw!.

senses.meaningEn: to give money for something you buy or use

examples.en: I'll pay for the coffee.
Did you pay the rent yet?

senses.note: pay for + 물건·서비스(pay for dinner), pay + 돈·요금(pay 10 dollars, pay the bill). 'pay the coffee' 는 틀림. 결제 수단: pay by card / in cash.

senses.meaningEn: the money you get for doing your job

examples.en: The pay is good, but the hours are long.
She got a pay raise last month.

senses.note: 불가산 명사. payday(월급날), pay raise(임금 인상), paycheck(급여, 급여 수표).

senses.meaningEn: to listen or watch carefully

examples.en: Pay attention to the teacher, please.
I didn't pay attention and missed the question.

senses.note: '집중하다'는 pay attention(give attention 은 어색). pay attention to + 대상. 과거형 paid attention. 전치사 to 를 빼먹는 실수가 많다: pay attention to me.

senses.meaningEn: to give someone the money you borrowed from them

examples.en: I'll pay you back on Friday.
She paid back the loan in two years.

senses.note: pay + 사람 + back 어순이 가장 자연스러움(pay me back). borrow(빌리다)/lend(빌려주다)와 함께 익히기.

senses.meaningEn: to do something bad to someone because they did something bad to you

examples.en: I'll pay him back for what he did.
examples.ko: 그가 한 짓은 꼭 갚아 줄 거야.

examples.en: She paid them back by ignoring them.

senses.note: pay someone back for + 잘못. 명사 payback(응보).

senses.meaningEn: to give money for something you buy or use

examples.en: Who's paying for dinner tonight?
I paid for the tickets with my card.

senses.note: pay + 금액/사람(pay $10, pay the waiter), pay for + 물건/서비스. pay the coffee ✗ → pay for the coffee. 과거형 paid.

senses.meaningEn: to suffer because of something bad you did

examples.en: You'll pay for lying to me.
He paid for his mistake with a bad grade.
examples.ko: 그는 실수의 대가로 나쁜 성적을 받았어.

senses.note: 비유적 쓰임. 드라마에서 You'll pay for this! 로 자주 들림.

senses.meaningEn: to finish paying all the money you owe

examples.en: We finally paid off the car.
It took ten years to pay off the loan.

senses.note: pay back 은 일부든 전부든 '갚다', pay off 는 '끝까지 다 갚다'. pay off a debt / a loan / a credit card.

senses.meaningEn: to bring a good result after a lot of effort

examples.en: All that studying really paid off.
examples.ko: 그렇게 공부한 게 정말 보람이 있었어.

examples.en: Hard work pays off in the end.

senses.note: 주어는 노력·연습·투자 등. 목적어 없이 쓰임. Your effort will pay off.(네 노력은 보답받을 거야).

senses.meaningEn: physical education; the school subject where you do sports and exercise

examples.en: We played basketball in PE today.
Don't forget your PE uniform tomorrow.

senses.note: physical education 의 약자, 대문자 PE 로 쓰고 글자 하나씩 /피이/로 읽음. PE class = 체육 수업, PE teacher = 체육 선생님. 미국에서는 gym (class) 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a time when there is no war or fighting

examples.en: Everyone hopes for peace in the world.
The two countries have lived in peace for years.
examples.ko: 두 나라는 수년간 평화롭게 지내 왔어.

senses.note: piece(조각)와 발음이 같으니 철자 주의. make peace(화해하다), peace talks(평화 회담).

senses.meaningEn: a calm and quiet state without worry or noise

examples.en: I just want some peace and quiet this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말엔 그냥 좀 조용히 쉬고 싶어.

examples.en: Leave me in peace. I'm trying to read.
examples.ko: 날 좀 가만히 둬. 책 읽으려고 하잖아.

senses.note: peace and quiet(평화롭고 조용한 시간), peace of mind(마음의 평안), in peace(편안히).

senses.meaningEn: a soft round fruit with a fuzzy skin and a large seed inside

examples.en: I bought some peaches at the market.
Peaches are in season in the summer.

senses.note: 복수형은 peaches. 색을 말할 때도 peach(살구색·복숭아색)라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a small nut with a soft brown shell that grows under the ground

examples.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
Do you want peanut butter on your toast?

senses.note: peanut butter(땅콩버터)는 미국 가정의 기본 식품. 알레르기 표시에서 자주 보는 단어.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom

examples.en: Would you like an apple or a pear?
Korean pears are big and very juicy.
examples.ko: 한국 배는 크고 아주 물이 많아.

senses.note: pair(한 쌍)와 발음이 같음. 한국 배는 Asian pear 또는 Korean pear 라고 구분해 부름.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with ink inside that you use to write

examples.en: Do you have a pen I can use?
examples.ko: 내가 쓸 수 있는 펜 있어?

examples.en: Please sign here with a black pen.

senses.note: 볼펜은 ballpoint pen 또는 그냥 pen. '볼펜' 그대로 ball pen 은 잘 안 씀. in pen = 펜으로. 사인펜은 marker.

senses.meaningEn: a thin wooden stick with a dark center used for writing or drawing

examples.en: Can I borrow a pencil, please?
Write your answers in pencil, not pen.

senses.note: in pencil = 연필로(관사 없음). pencil case = 필통, pencil sharpener = 연필깎이. 샤프펜슬은 mechanical pencil.

senses.meaningEn: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly but swims very well and lives in cold places

examples.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim really well.
examples.ko: 펭귄은 날지 못하지만 수영은 정말 잘해.

examples.en: The penguins at the aquarium were so cute.

senses.note: 펭귄은 날지 못하는 새(bird). 발음은 '펭귄'보다 '펭그윈'(/ˈpeŋɡwɪn/)에 가까움. 펭귄은 뒤뚱뒤뚱 걷다 = waddle.

senses.meaningEn: persons in general; more than one person

examples.en: There were so many people at the mall.
Most people like to sleep in on Sundays.
examples.ko: 대부분의 사람들은 일요일에 늦잠 자는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: people 은 이미 복수이므로 peoples, many peoples 라고 쓰지 않음. People are... (is 아님).

senses.meaningEn: all the persons who live in a country or belong to one group

examples.en: The Korean people love their food.
The president spoke to the people on TV.

senses.note: 이 뜻에서는 the people 로 쓰며, 여러 민족을 말할 때만 peoples 복수가 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a hot-tasting black or white powder used to add flavor to food

examples.en: Would you like some pepper on your salad?
Add salt and pepper to taste.

senses.note: 후추는 셀 수 없음: black pepper(검은 후추). 후추통은 pepper shaker, 후추 그라인더는 pepper mill.

senses.meaningEn: a hollow green, red, or yellow vegetable, or a small hot one used in spicy food

examples.en: I bought red and green peppers for the salad.
examples.ko: 샐러드용으로 빨간 피망과 초록 피망을 샀어.

examples.en: These little peppers are really spicy!

senses.note: 채소일 때는 셀 수 있음. 피망·파프리카는 bell pepper, 매운 고추는 chili pepper 또는 hot pepper. 한국어 '파프리카'는 영어로 bell pepper 라고 해야 통함.

senses.meaningEn: with nothing wrong; as good as possible

examples.en: Your English is perfect!
Nobody is perfect, so don't worry about it.

senses.note: very perfect 라고 하지 않음(이미 최상의 뜻). 약속 시간을 정할 때 Perfect! = '좋아, 딱이야'. 명사 perfection, 부사 perfectly.

senses.meaningEn: exactly right for a person, purpose, or situation

examples.en: This dress is perfect for the party.
It's a perfect day for a picnic.

senses.note: perfect for + 용도/사람 = ~에 딱 맞다. 옷 사이즈가 맞을 때 It fits perfectly.

senses.meaningEn: to sing, dance, act, or play music for an audience

examples.en: The band will perform at the school festival.
examples.ko: 그 밴드가 학교 축제에서 공연할 거야.

examples.en: She performed a song for her grandmother.
examples.ko: 그녀는 할머니를 위해 노래 한 곡을 불렀어.

senses.note: perform a song/dance/play. 공연 = performance, 공연자 = performer.

senses.meaningEn: to do a task or job

examples.en: The students performed well on the test.
The doctor performed the operation this morning.

senses.note: perform well/badly 로 "잘하다/못하다"를 격식 있게 표현. do 보다 조금 격식적.

senses.meaningEn: maybe; possibly

examples.en: Perhaps we can meet next week instead.
Perhaps she forgot about the meeting.

senses.note: maybe 와 뜻은 같지만 조금 더 격식적·부드러움. 정중한 제안: Perhaps you could try again.

senses.meaningEn: one human being

examples.en: She is a very kind person.
Only one person can sit here.
examples.ko: 여기엔 한 사람만 앉을 수 있어.

senses.note: 복수는 보통 people. persons 는 법률·공식 안내문에서만 (예: Maximum 4 persons).

senses.meaningEn: used in 'in person': by being there yourself, not by phone or online

examples.en: Let's meet in person next week.
You have to sign the paper in person.
examples.ko: 서류는 본인이 직접 와서 서명해야 해.

senses.note: in person = 직접, 대면으로. 온라인 회의와 대비할 때 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: an animal that you keep at home for company

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home?
My pet is a small white dog.

senses.note: pet shop(펫숍), pet food. 반려동물 주인은 pet owner.

senses.meaningEn: to touch an animal gently with your hand

examples.en: Can I pet your dog?
She petted the cat softly.

senses.note: 과거형은 t 를 겹쳐 petted. 사람을 쓰다듬을 때는 stroke 나 pat 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a shop or a counter in a shop where you can get medicine

examples.en: Take this to the pharmacy to get your medicine.
The pharmacy closes at nine on weekdays.

senses.note: 처방약을 받는 곳. 약사는 pharmacist. 미국에서 일상적으로는 drugstore 라고도 하고, 영국은 chemist's 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a device you use to call people, send messages, and go online

examples.en: I left my phone at home today.
Can I borrow your phone for a second?
examples.ko: 잠깐 네 폰 좀 빌려도 돼?

senses.note: cell phone(미) / mobile phone(영). 요즘은 phone 만 해도 스마트폰을 뜻함. on the phone = 통화 중. 한국어 "핸드폰(hand phone)"은 안 통함.

senses.meaningEn: to call someone on the phone

examples.en: Phone me when you get home.
I'll phone the restaurant and book a table.

senses.note: 미국에서는 call 이 더 흔함. phone to me (X) → phone me.

senses.meaningEn: the series of numbers you dial to call someone

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
I lost my phone, so I don't have your phone number anymore.

senses.note: 전화번호를 '묻다'는 Can I have / get your phone number? 또는 What's your (phone) number? 번호를 '알려 주다'는 give someone your number. 번호를 읽을 때 0 은 oh 또는 zero, 같은 숫자 두 번은 double(double five).

senses.meaningEn: a large musical instrument with black and white keys that you press

examples.en: My daughter plays the piano every evening.
Can you play this song on the piano?
examples.ko: 이 노래 피아노로 칠 수 있어?

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the — play the piano. '피아노 레슨'은 piano lesson, 피아노 연주자는 pianist. 한국어 '피아노를 치다'를 hit 으로 옮기면 안 되고 play.

senses.meaningEn: to choose something from a group

examples.en: Pick any color you like.
Who picked this restaurant? It's great!
examples.ko: 이 식당 누가 골랐어? 정말 좋다!

senses.note: choose 보다 가볍고 구어적. 명사로도: Take your pick. = 골라 봐. pick out = 골라내다.

senses.meaningEn: to take a flower or fruit from a plant with your fingers

examples.en: We picked apples at a farm last weekend.
Don't pick the flowers in the park.

senses.note: pick strawberries/apples. 과일 따기 체험 = fruit picking.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something from a surface, or to go and get someone in a car

examples.en: Pick up your toys before dinner.
I'll pick you up at seven in front of the station.

senses.note: pick up 은 '집어 들다·치우다', '태우러 가다', '(전화를) 받다', '(물건을) 사 오다' 등 뜻이 많음. 내려 주다는 drop off.

senses.meaningEn: to keep treating someone badly or unfairly, often because they are weaker

examples.en: Stop picking on your little sister!
Some kids picked on him at school.

senses.note: Why are you picking on me? = 왜 나만 갖고 그래? 한국어 '꼬투리 잡다' 느낌도 있음. 목적어는 항상 on 뒤.

senses.meaningEn: to choose someone to do something, often something they do not want to do

examples.en: The teacher always picks on me to answer.
examples.ko: 선생님은 항상 나를 지목해서 대답하게 해.

examples.en: Why did they pick on you to clean up?
examples.ko: 왜 너를 골라서 청소를 시킨 거야?

senses.note: 억지로 시키는 느낌의 '지목'. 중립적인 선택은 pick / choose.

senses.meaningEn: to choose something from a group

examples.en: Help me pick out a gift for Mom.
examples.ko: 엄마 선물 고르는 것 좀 도와줘.

examples.en: She picked out a blue dress for the party.
examples.ko: 그녀는 파티에 입을 파란 드레스를 골랐어.

senses.note: choose 보다 구어적. 여러 개 중에 눈으로 보고 고를 때 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to recognize someone or something among many others

examples.en: Can you pick out your brother in this photo?
examples.ko: 이 사진에서 네 형 찾을 수 있어?

examples.en: I picked her voice out from the crowd.

senses.note: 많은 것 중에서 '하나를 집어내듯' 알아보는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something from a surface

examples.en: Please pick up your toys from the floor.
He picked up the phone and said hello.
examples.ko: 그는 전화기를 들고 여보세요 라고 했어.

senses.meaningEn: to go and get someone in a car

examples.en: Can you pick me up at the station?
examples.ko: 역에서 나 좀 태워 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I pick up my kids from school at three.

senses.note: pick + 사람 + up 순서로도 씀: pick me up. 반대는 drop off(내려 주다).

senses.meaningEn: to buy or collect something, often casually

examples.en: Could you pick up some bread on your way?
examples.ko: 오는 길에 빵 좀 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: I need to pick up my package at the post office.

senses.meaningEn: to learn something easily without much effort

examples.en: Kids pick up new words very quickly.
examples.ko: 아이들은 새 단어를 아주 빨리 익혀.

examples.en: I picked up some Spanish while traveling.

senses.meaningEn: a meal that you eat outside, such as in a park

examples.en: Let's have a picnic in the park this Saturday.
We packed sandwiches for the picnic.

senses.note: have a picnic / go on a picnic. 한국어 '소풍'이 학교 행사면 school trip / field trip 이 더 맞음. picnic 은 야외에서 먹는 식사가 핵심.

senses.meaningEn: a drawing or painting

examples.en: My daughter drew a picture of our dog.
There's a big picture on the living room wall.
examples.ko: 거실 벽에 큰 그림이 걸려 있어.

senses.note: draw a picture = 그림을 그리다(색칠하는 그림은 paint). 그림 '속의' = in the picture.

senses.meaningEn: a photograph

examples.en: Can you take a picture of us, please?
examples.ko: 저희 사진 한 장 찍어 주실래요?

examples.en: I took a lot of pictures on my trip.

senses.note: take a picture = 사진을 찍다(make ✗). photo 와 거의 같은 뜻으로 일상에서 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a baked dish with a pastry crust and a sweet or savory filling

examples.en: My mom makes the best apple pie.
Would you like a slice of pie?

senses.note: a slice of pie = 파이 한 조각. 단 것(apple pie)뿐 아니라 고기 파이(meat pie)도 있음. as easy as pie = 아주 쉬운.

senses.meaningEn: a part that is cut or broken from something bigger

examples.en: Would you like another piece of cake?
Cut the apple into small pieces.

senses.note: slice 는 얇게 '썬' 조각(피자·빵), piece 는 모양과 상관없는 조각 전체를 가리킨다. in pieces = 산산조각 난.

senses.meaningKo: (셀 수 없는 명사를 세는) 하나, 한 장
senses.meaningEn: one item of something you cannot count directly

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.

senses.note: a piece of paper/furniture/advice/news/information 처럼 셀 수 없는 명사를 셀 때 쓴다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: an advice (X) → a piece of advice (O). 발음은 peace(평화)와 같다.

senses.meaningKo: 아주 쉬운 일, 식은 죽 먹기
senses.meaningEn: something that is very easy to do

examples.en: The test was a piece of cake.
Don't worry, fixing this is a piece of cake.
examples.ko: 걱정 마, 이거 고치는 건 아주 쉬워.

senses.note: 항상 a piece of cake 로 씀. 실제 케이크 한 조각이라는 뜻과 구별은 문맥으로.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with a fat body, short legs, and a curly tail

examples.en: The pigs are rolling in the mud.
My uncle keeps pigs and chickens on his farm.

senses.note: 돼지고기는 pork, 새끼 돼지는 piglet. 돼지 소리는 oink.

senses.meaningEn: a person who eats too much or is dirty and messy

examples.en: Don't be a pig and share the pizza.
I ate like a pig at the party last night.

senses.note: eat like a pig = 게걸스럽게 먹다. 친구 사이에 장난으로는 쓰지만 남에게 쓰면 무례함.

senses.meaningEn: to make a pile of things, or to become a pile

examples.en: Dirty dishes piled up in the sink all week.
Pile up the boxes in the corner, please.

senses.note: 명사 pile(더미): a pile of books. 자동사(쌓이다)·타동사(쌓다) 모두 가능.

senses.meaningEn: if work, bills, or problems pile up, they increase and become hard to deal with

examples.en: My homework is piling up this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 숙제가 쌓여 가고 있어.

examples.en: The bills piled up while I was sick.

senses.note: work / bills / problems pile up — 처리하지 못해 늘어나는 부정적 느낌. 명사 pile-up 은 '다중 추돌 사고'.

senses.meaningEn: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow

examples.en: Take one pill with a glass of water.
examples.ko: 알약 하나를 물 한 잔과 함께 먹어요.

examples.en: These pills are too big for me to swallow.
examples.ko: 이 알약은 너무 커서 삼키기 힘들어.

senses.note: take a pill(알약을 먹다). sleeping pill(수면제), vitamin pill. 비슷한 말 tablet(정제), capsule(캡슐).

senses.meaningEn: a soft object that you rest your head on in bed

examples.en: This pillow is too soft for me.
Can I get an extra pillow, please?
examples.ko: 베개 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

senses.note: 베갯잇은 pillowcase. 소파의 장식 쿠션은 cushion 또는 throw pillow.

senses.meaningEn: a person who flies a plane

examples.en: The pilot said we will land in twenty minutes.
She trained for years to become a pilot.
examples.ko: 그녀는 조종사가 되려고 몇 년을 훈련했어.

senses.note: 기내 방송의 '기장'은 captain 이라고도 부름. 부조종사는 co-pilot.

senses.meaningEn: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

examples.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
Fresh pineapple is hard to cut.

senses.note: 음식 재료로 말할 때는 셀 수 없는 명사처럼 pineapple 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: having a pale red color

examples.en: My little sister loves pink dresses.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 분홍 드레스를 아주 좋아해.

examples.en: The cherry blossoms are light pink.

senses.note: hot pink(진한 핑크), light/pale pink(연분홍). "핑크"로 그대로 쓰는 외래어.

senses.meaningEn: the color pink

examples.en: Can I see this case in pink?
examples.ko: 이 케이스 핑크색으로 볼 수 있을까요?

examples.en: Pink and gray look nice together.

senses.meaningEn: a flat, round bread baked with tomato sauce, cheese, and other food on top

examples.en: Let's order a pizza tonight.
Can I have one more slice of pizza?
examples.ko: 피자 한 조각 더 먹어도 돼?

senses.note: 피자 한 판은 a pizza, 한 조각은 a slice of pizza. '피자 한 조각' 을 a piece 라고 해도 되지만 slice 가 더 자연스러움. 발음은 [핏자]에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: an idea about what you are going to do

examples.en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
Our plan is to leave at eight.

senses.note: '주말 계획 있어?'는 보통 복수 plans 로 물음. make a plan / change of plans(계획 변경).

senses.meaningEn: to decide in detail what you will do, or intend to do something

examples.en: We're planning a trip to Busan next month.
examples.ko: 다음 달에 부산 여행을 계획하고 있어.

examples.en: I plan to study English every morning.
examples.ko: 매일 아침 영어 공부를 할 예정이야.

senses.note: plan to + 동사. 과거형·진행형은 n 을 겹쳐 planned / planning.

senses.meaningEn: an airplane

examples.en: What time does your plane leave?
I slept on the plane the whole time.

senses.note: airplane 의 줄임말로, 구어에서는 plane 이 기본. 비행기를 타다 = get on/board a plane, 놓치다 = miss the plane. 발음이 같은 plain(평범한, 무늬 없는)과 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a living thing that grows in the ground and has leaves and roots

examples.en: I water my plants every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 화초에 물을 줘.

examples.en: This plant needs a lot of sun.

senses.note: 집 안의 화분 식물은 houseplant. 식물에 '물을 주다'는 water a plant.

senses.meaningEn: to put a seed or young plant in the ground so it grows

examples.en: We planted a tree in the garden.
When do you plant tomatoes?

senses.meaningEn: a factory or a building where power is made

examples.en: My uncle works at a car plant.
There is a power plant near the river.

senses.note: power plant = 발전소. '식물'과 전혀 다른 뜻이니 문맥으로 구별.

senses.meaningEn: a flat round dish that you eat food from

examples.en: Can you put the plates on the table?
Be careful, that plate is hot.

senses.meaningEn: the food on a plate

examples.en: I'd like a plate of pasta, please.
He finished his whole plate in five minutes.
examples.ko: 그는 한 접시를 5분 만에 다 먹었어.

senses.note: a plate of pasta / fries. 평평한 접시에 담는 음식. 깊은 그릇은 bowl.

senses.meaningEn: the raised area next to the train tracks where you wait for a train

examples.en: The train to Boston leaves from platform three.
Stand back from the edge of the platform.

senses.note: 미국에서는 track 3 처럼 track 으로 안내하는 경우도 많음. 영국은 platform 이 일반적.

senses.meaningEn: a website or app system that people use to share things or do business

examples.en: Which platform do you use to watch movies?
examples.ko: 영화 볼 때 어떤 플랫폼 써?

examples.en: This game works on every platform, even phones.
examples.ko: 이 게임은 휴대폰까지 모든 플랫폼에서 돌아가.

senses.note: social media platform(소셜 미디어 플랫폼) 처럼 쓰임. 한국어 '플랫폼'과 거의 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to take part in a game or sport, or to have fun

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
Do you want to play soccer after school?

senses.note: play soccer / play games. 구기 종목은 play, 수영·달리기는 go swimming / go running.

senses.meaningEn: to make music with an instrument

examples.en: She plays the piano really well.
I'm learning to play the guitar.

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the: play the piano. 운동 앞에는 the 없음: play tennis.

senses.meaningEn: to make a song or video start

examples.en: Can you play that song again?
Press here to play the video.

senses.meaningEn: a story performed by actors in a theater

examples.en: We saw a play at the theater last night.
My daughter is in the school play.

senses.meaningEn: to take part in a game for fun, such as a board game or video game

examples.en: Let's play a game while we wait.
The children played a game in the backyard.

senses.note: 비디오 게임은 play video games / play games on my phone. '게임 하다'를 do a game ✗ 으로 쓰지 않음. 운동 경기 한 판도 play a game of tennis / have a game.

senses.meaningEn: to pretend to agree with someone or join in a plan, often to avoid trouble or for fun

examples.en: Just play along and don't ask questions.
examples.ko: 일단 맞춰 주고 아무것도 묻지 마.

examples.en: I didn't like the joke, but I played along.
examples.ko: 그 농담이 별로였지만 그냥 맞춰 줬어.

senses.note: play along with + 사람/계획. 속으로는 동의하지 않아도 겉으로 따라 준다는 뉘앙스. 깜짝 파티 준비 같은 상황에서 자주 들림.

senses.meaningEn: to play music or a game together with others who are already playing

examples.en: Grab a guitar and play along with us.
examples.ko: 기타 하나 들고 우리랑 같이 연주해.

examples.en: Viewers can play along with the quiz at home.
examples.ko: 시청자들도 집에서 퀴즈에 함께 참여할 수 있어.

senses.note: play along to a song = 노래에 맞춰 연주하다. 퀴즈 쇼의 'play along at home' 은 단골 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to play a game using a pack of playing cards

examples.en: We played cards all night at my grandma's house.
examples.ko: 할머니 집에서 밤새 카드 게임을 했어.

examples.en: Do you want to play cards after dinner?

senses.note: 관사 없이 복수 cards. '카드 한 판'은 a game of cards. '카드를 섞다'는 shuffle the cards, '카드를 나누다'는 deal the cards.

senses.meaningEn: to take part in a game of soccer

examples.en: I play soccer with my friends every Saturday.
examples.ko: 나는 매주 토요일에 친구들과 축구를 해.

examples.en: The kids played soccer in the park until dark.
examples.ko: 아이들은 어두워질 때까지 공원에서 축구를 했어.

senses.note: 구기 종목은 play + 종목명(관사 없음): play soccer / basketball / tennis. 영국식은 football. 운동을 '하다'를 do soccer ✗ 로 쓰지 않음. 격투기·무도는 do(do taekwondo).

senses.meaningEn: to make music on a piano

examples.en: My sister can play the piano really well.
examples.ko: 우리 언니는 피아노를 정말 잘 쳐.

examples.en: He played the piano at the school concert.

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the: play the piano / the guitar / the violin(play piano 도 미국 구어에서 들림). 운동은 the 없음(play soccer). '피아노를 배우다'는 take piano lessons.

senses.meaningEn: to spend time having fun with a person, a pet, or a toy

examples.en: Can I go play with my friends?
The cat loves playing with this ball.
examples.ko: 고양이가 이 공을 가지고 노는 걸 정말 좋아해.

senses.note: play with + 사람(~와 놀다) / 장난감(~을 가지고 놀다). 한국어 '놀다'를 어른들의 '만나서 놀다'로 쓸 때는 hang out with 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to keep touching or moving something, often without thinking

examples.en: Stop playing with your hair and listen.
She just played with her food and didn't eat.
examples.ko: 그녀는 음식을 깨작거리기만 하고 안 먹었어.

senses.note: play with your food = 음식을 먹지 않고 깨작거리다(부모가 아이에게 자주 하는 말). play with someone's feelings = 감정을 가지고 놀다.

senses.meaningEn: a person who plays a sport or a game

examples.en: He's the best player on the team.
This game needs at least four players.
examples.ko: 이 게임은 최소 네 명이 필요해.

senses.note: soccer player, tennis player, basketball player. 한국어 '운동선수' 일반은 athlete. 게임 참가자도 player.

senses.meaningEn: a person who plays a musical instrument

examples.en: My sister is a great piano player.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 피아노를 아주 잘 쳐.

examples.en: The guitar player in that band is amazing.

senses.note: piano player = pianist, guitar player = guitarist. 일상에서는 -player 가 더 쉽고 자연스러움. 재생 기기(music player, DVD player)도 player.

senses.meaningEn: an outdoor area where children can play

examples.en: The kids are on the playground.
We played tag in the school playground.

senses.note: on the playground(미) / in the playground(영). 미끄럼틀·그네가 있는 놀이터와 학교 운동장 둘 다 가리킴.

senses.meaningEn: used to ask for something politely

examples.en: Can I have some water, please?
Please sit down and wait here.

senses.note: 문장 앞이나 끝(끝에 올 땐 쉼표). 식당·가게에서 주문할 때 명사 + please 만으로도 충분: Two coffees, please. 권유에 응할 때 Yes, please.

senses.meaningEn: to make someone happy or satisfied

examples.en: It's hard to please everyone.
She cooked his favorite meal to please him.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그를 기쁘게 하려고 그가 좋아하는 음식을 만들었어.

senses.note: 형용사 pleased(기쁜): I'm pleased to meet you. 명사 pleasure: My pleasure.(천만에요).

senses.meaningEn: happy and satisfied about something

examples.en: I'm pleased with my test score.
Nice to meet you. Pleased to meet you too.

senses.note: pleased with + 명사, pleased to + 동사. happy 보다 약간 차분하고 격식 있는 느낌. Pleased to meet you. 는 첫 만남 인사.

senses.meaningEn: to connect a machine to the electricity or to another device

examples.en: Plug in your phone before you sleep.
Is the printer plugged in?

senses.note: plug it in(연결하다) ↔ unplug it(뽑다). 콘센트 = outlet(미) / socket(영). '콘센트'는 영어로 안 통함.

senses.meaningEn: a small bag sewn into clothes for keeping small things

examples.en: I put my keys in my pocket.
This jacket has four pockets.

senses.note: pocket money = 용돈(영국식). 가방 주머니도 pocket. 한국어 '포켓'처럼 발음하지 말고 /ˈpɑːkɪt/ 로.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of writing in short lines that uses rhythm, sounds, and feelings

examples.en: We read a poem about spring in class.
examples.ko: 수업 시간에 봄에 관한 시를 읽었어.

examples.en: She wrote a poem for her mother.

senses.note: poem = 시 한 편(셀 수 있음), poetry = 시 장르 전체(셀 수 없음), poet = 시인. write/read/recite a poem.

senses.meaningEn: a unit used to count the score in a game or sport

examples.en: We won the game by two points.
You get ten points for each correct answer.

senses.note: score a point(점수를 내다), lose points(점수를 잃다). 시험 점수는 보통 score 나 grade 를 쓰고, points 는 게임·퀴즈 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the main idea or purpose of something

examples.en: What's your point? Just tell me.
There's no point in waiting any longer.

senses.note: Good point!(좋은 지적이야), That's the point.(바로 그거야), There's no point in -ing(~해도 소용없다). 회화에서 매우 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: to show where something is using your finger

examples.en: She pointed at the big red house.
Don't point at people, it's rude.
examples.ko: 사람을 손가락으로 가리키지 마, 예의 없어.

senses.note: point at/to + 대상. point out(지적하다, 알려주다)은 자주 쓰는 구동사: Thanks for pointing that out.

senses.meaningEn: the small dot in a decimal number, or the sharp end of something

examples.en: Three point five means 3.5.
The point of the pencil broke again.

senses.note: 소수점은 point 로 읽음(2.75 = two point seven five). 연필심 끝도 point, 뾰족하다는 pointed/sharp.

senses.meaningEn: to show something or someone by holding out your finger toward them

examples.en: It's rude to point at people.
examples.ko: 사람을 손가락으로 가리키는 건 예의가 없어.

examples.en: The boy pointed at the toy he wanted.

senses.note: point at = 특정 대상을 콕 가리킴. point to 는 방향·위치를 가리키거나 '~을 시사하다' 로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to aim or hold something so it faces a particular direction

examples.en: Point the camera at me and smile!
Don't point the fan at the baby.
examples.ko: 선풍기를 아기 쪽으로 향하게 하지 마.

senses.note: point A at B = A 를 B 에 향하다/겨누다. 리모컨, 카메라, 플래시 등에 자주.

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone a fact or mistake that they did not notice

examples.en: Thanks for pointing out my mistake.
She pointed out that the store closes early today.
examples.ko: 그녀는 오늘 가게가 일찍 닫는다고 알려 줬어.

senses.note: point out that + 문장 형태로 자주 씀. 한국어 '지적하다' 보다 어감이 덜 날카로움 — 그냥 '말해 주다' 에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: to show someone where a person or thing is by pointing at it

examples.en: Can you point out the station on the map?
examples.ko: 지도에서 역이 어디인지 가리켜 줄 수 있어요?

examples.en: He pointed out his house as we drove by.
examples.ko: 차로 지나가면서 그는 자기 집을 가리켜 보여 줬어.

senses.note: 목적어는 중간·뒤 모두 가능: point it out / point out the building.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to keep people safe and make sure they follow the law

examples.en: A police officer helped me find my way.
My aunt is a police officer in Seoul.

senses.note: policeman/policewoman 보다 성 중립적인 police officer 가 요즘 표준. the police(경찰 조직)는 복수 취급: The police are here.

senses.meaningEn: the office building where police officers work

examples.en: The police station is next to the bank.
I lost my wallet, so I went to the police station.

senses.note: police 는 항상 복수 취급(The police are coming). 경찰관 한 명은 a police officer. 긴급 전화는 미국 911.

senses.meaningEn: behaving in a way that shows respect for other people

examples.en: It's polite to say thank you.
The waiter was very polite and friendly.

senses.note: polite to + 사람. 부사 politely(Ask politely). 한국어 '존댓말' 에 꼭 맞는 단어는 없고 polite language 로 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a small area of still water, smaller than a lake

examples.en: There are ducks in the pond.
My grandfather has a small fish pond.
examples.ko: 우리 할아버지는 작은 물고기 연못이 있어.

senses.note: lake 보다 훨씬 작은 물. 정원 연못 = garden pond, 물고기 연못 = fish pond.

senses.meaningEn: a large area of water made for people to swim in

examples.en: The kids are playing in the pool.
Our hotel has a pool on the roof.

senses.note: swimming pool 의 줄임말로 일상에서는 pool 만 많이 씀. 수영장에서 '수영하다'는 swim in the pool, 수영장 '가다'는 go to the pool.

senses.meaningEn: a small area of liquid on a surface

examples.en: There was a pool of water on the kitchen floor.
After the rain, little pools formed on the road.
examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤 길에 작은 물웅덩이들이 생겼어.

senses.note: a pool of water/blood 처럼 '~이 고인 것'. 빗물 웅덩이는 puddle 이 더 흔함. 당구(포켓볼)도 pool 이라고 함(play pool).

senses.meaningEn: having very little money

examples.en: They were poor, but they shared everything.
Many poor families need help this winter.
examples.ko: 이번 겨울 많은 가난한 가정이 도움이 필요해.

senses.note: the poor = 가난한 사람들. 명사는 poverty. 조금 돈이 없을 때는 I'm broke(구어) 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: used to show sympathy for someone

examples.en: Poor Tom! He lost his wallet again.
The poor dog was waiting in the rain.
examples.ko: 그 가엾은 개는 빗속에서 기다리고 있었어.

senses.note: Poor you! / Poor thing! = '어쩜, 안됐다'. 이 뜻에서는 항상 명사 앞에 옴.

senses.meaningEn: of low quality or not good at something

examples.en: My eyesight is quite poor.
He got a poor grade on the test.

senses.note: poor at + 활동(I'm poor at math) 은 bad at 보다 약간 격식. poor health, poor quality 콜로케이션.

senses.meaningEn: to visit a place quickly for a short time

examples.en: Pop in for a coffee if you have time.
examples.ko: 시간 있으면 커피 한잔하러 잠깐 들러.

examples.en: I just popped in to say hello.

senses.note: 매우 구어적. 영국에서 특히 자주 쓰고, 미국에서는 stop by / drop by 가 더 흔함. pop out = 잠깐 나가다.

senses.meaningEn: liked by many people

examples.en: This song is really popular right now.
examples.ko: 이 노래 지금 정말 인기 많아.

examples.en: He's the most popular boy in our class.
examples.ko: 그는 우리 반에서 가장 인기 있는 남자애야.

senses.note: popular with + 사람(popular with teenagers). 한국어 '인기' 는 명사지만 popular 는 형용사 — '인기가 많다' = be popular. 명사형은 popularity.

senses.meaningEn: done or believed by many people in general

examples.en: Soccer is a popular sport around the world.
Camping is becoming popular with families.

senses.meaningEn: the meat from a pig

examples.en: Does this soup have pork in it?
We're grilling pork belly tonight.

senses.note: 동물은 pig, 고기는 pork. 셀 수 없는 명사. pork belly(삼겹살), pork cutlet(돈가스), pork chop(뼈 있는 등심).

senses.meaningEn: able to happen or be done

examples.en: Is it possible to change my ticket?
Please come as soon as possible.

senses.note: It is possible to + 동사 / It is possible that... 사람을 주어로 I'm possible 은 틀림. as soon as possible(ASAP) = 가능한 한 빨리. 부사 possibly, 명사 possibility.

senses.meaningEn: to put a message, photo, or video on a website or social media

examples.en: She posted a photo of her cat.
Don't post anything personal online.

senses.note: SNS 에서 가장 많이 쓰는 동사. 명사 a post = 게시물.

senses.meaningEn: the system of sending letters and packages

examples.en: I'll send the gift by post.
Did any post come today?

senses.note: 영국식. 미국에서는 mail 을 씀(by mail). 우체국은 post office 로 양쪽 모두 통함.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can send letters and packages and buy stamps

examples.en: Is there a post office near here?
